items.title: Extremal regions in Cases 1–4

article.statement:
We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~5.1, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

The lower embeddings are \(a:G\to A\), \(b:D\to A\), and \(c:F\to D\).
The upper ones are \(d:C\to G\), \(e:E\to C\), and \(f:E\to F\).
After merging parallel strands, the bottom basis is \(A\), with actions
through \(a,bc\). The top basis is \(G\times_E F\), balanced using \(de,f\).

With a group element at each vertex, either shape evaluates to
\(Q_p^!\), the sum over the fibers of
\[
 Q_p([g,h])=a(g)p(bc)(h),\qquad [g,h]\in G\times_E F,
\]
for a unique \(p\in A\). Its admissibility condition and fiber size over its image are
\begin{equation}\label{eq:three-projection-index}
 \begin{gathered}
 (ade)(v)p=p(bcf)(v)\qquad(v\in E),\\
 n_p=[a(G)\cap p(bc)(F)p^{-1}:(ade)(E)]<\infty .
 \end{gathered}
\end{equation}
A diagram with linear labels evaluates to a finite linear combination
of these \(Q_p^!\). Its coefficients are determined by the evaluated map.

Use the embeddings \(a,b,c,d,e,f\) of Cases~1--4 and fix an
admissible group-element crossing element \(p\in A\).
For Cases~1 and~3 the least transported right region is
\[
 P_p=\left\langle (ad)(C),\,p(bc)(F)p^{-1}\right\rangle.
\]
For Cases~2 and~4 the greatest transported left region is
\(B_{\max}=a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}\). More precisely, every parabolic \(B\)
in the interval
\[
 (ade)(E)\le B\le a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}
\]
is a possible transported left region. With the largest choice
in Case~2 the first projection has one preimage on its image.
article.locator: Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Proposition 8.6 [prop:parabolic-three-outside], p. 38 (related source excerpts on pp. 22, 38)

items.title: The two projection fiber indices for transported intermediate groups

article.statement:
We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Use the embeddings \(a,b,c,d,e,f\) of Cases~1--4 and fix an
admissible group-element crossing element \(p\in A\).
For Cases~1 and~3 the least transported right region is
\[
 P_p=\left\langle (ad)(C),\,p(bc)(F)p^{-1}\right\rangle.
\]
For Cases~2 and~4 the greatest transported left region is
\(B_{\max}=a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}\). More precisely, every parabolic \(B\)
in the interval
\[
 (ade)(E)\le B\le a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}
\]
is a possible transported left region. With the largest choice
in Case~2 the first projection has one preimage on its image.

In the left diagram, transport the image \(a r(B)\) by \(a(z^{-1})\)
using the notation of Lemma~6.3. It
contains \((ade)(E)\) by the upper vertex, is contained in \(a(G)\),
and is contained in \(p b(D)p^{-1}\) by the lower vertex and
\(p=a(z^{-1})x b(y)\). Conversely, for any \(B\) in the interval,
take \(r=a^{-1}|_B\),
\(s=b^{-1}\circ\operatorname{Ad}_{p^{-1}}|_B\), \(t=ade\),
and use \(x=p,\ y=z=1\). Here \(st=cf\) is the admissibility
condition on \(p\). In Case~2, transporting the two stabilizer
indices to \(A\) gives
\[
 [a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}:B],\qquad
 [B\cap p(bc)(F)p^{-1}:(ade)(E)].
\]
Both indices are finite because the ambient groups are finite.
The first is \(1\) at the maximum. Reversing the arrows gives
the corresponding choice in Case~4.
article.locator: Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, proof of Proposition 8.6, p. 38

items.title: Least parabolic right region for a specified linear-label placement

article.statement:
We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

The bounds are for one crossing element. For several crossing elements \(p\) with the
same two dots \(\ell=p_0^{-1}\) and \(m=1\) on the right, a single
diagram can put all coefficients at the third dot. The least
region for this placement is the smallest parabolic subgroup of
\(A\) containing
\[
 (ad)(C),\qquad p_0(bc)(F)p_0^{-1},\qquad pp_0^{-1}
 \quad\text{for every crossing element \(p\)}.
\]
Indeed, the third dot must contain \(pp_0^{-1}\) since
\(p=u(n)p_0\). Conversely, take the inclusion \(u\),
\(v=ad\), \(w=\operatorname{Ad}_{p_0}\circ bc\), and put the
coefficients on those elements \(n=pp_0^{-1}\).
Apply Lemma~7.2 to the subgroup
generated by the displayed elements and subgroups.

items.title: Projected pair stabilizer of an orbit supported by a left diagram

article.statement:
We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Write \(a:A\to G\), \(b:A\to D\), and \(d:F\to D\) for the lower
embeddings and \(c:C\to G\), \(e:C\to E\), and \(f:F\to E\) for the upper ones.
The source basis is \(G\times_A D\) and the target basis is \(G\times_C E\).

In the notation of Lemma~6.6, the
left equation compares the two maps
\[
 [g,x]_A\longmapsto u(g)r v(x)t,\qquad
 [h,y]_C\longmapsto u(h)s w(y).
\]
Both are equivariant for the action of \(G\times F\) on \(B\)
given by \((q,k)\cdot z=u(q)z\,w(f(k))^{-1}\). This follows from
the three vertex equations, including
\(vd=\operatorname{Ad}_t\circ wf\).
A supported pair has the same image \(z\) under the two maps.
If \(k\in F\) lies in both individual stabilizer projections,
the corresponding \(G\)-components \(q_1,q_2\) satisfy
\[
 u(q_1)=z\,w(f(k))\,z^{-1}=u(q_2).
\]
Since \(u\) is injective, \(q_1=q_2\). Hence the projected pair
stabilizer is exactly the intersection of the two individual
projections. For a representative \(([1,x]_A,[h,y]_C)\), those
projections are \(d^{-1}(x^{-1}b(A)x)\) and
\(f^{-1}(y^{-1}e(C)y)\), with inverse images taken in \(F\).
They are finite parabolics by conjugation and intersection
closure. The orbit term in Theorem~6.7 can
therefore use the full stabilizer and counts each pair once.
Every left basis coefficient is \(1\) on a supported pair by
(6.3).
article.locator: Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, proof of Proposition 8.7, pp. 39–40

items.title: Right-diagram span over a commutative ring and its integral quotient

article.statement:
We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

A left diagram in Case~5 with group-element dots is a sum of
right diagrams, one for each supported orbit of input--output
pairs, each with coefficient \(1\). Write \(\mathcal S\) for this
set of orbits, \(P_{\mathcal O}\) for each projected stabilizer, and
\(T_{\mathcal O}\) for the matrix with coefficient \(1\) on \(\mathcal O\) and
\(0\) elsewhere.
For any orbit of input--output pairs, let \(P\le F\) be the
projection of its stabilizer. Among single right diagrams with
group-element dots realizing this orbit, the least multiplicity
is \([P:L]\), where \(L\) is generated by all transpositions in \(P\).
It equals \(1\) exactly when \(P\) is parabolic.

For these two three-crossing shapes, the same basis formulas work
over any commutative ring \(R\) with identity. For each orbit
\(\mathcal O\) of input--output pairs, let \(L_{\mathcal O}\) be the
largest parabolic subgroup of \(P_{\mathcal O}\). The \(R\)-span of
right diagrams in the space of bimodule maps is
\[
 \bigoplus_{\mathcal O}
    \bigl([P_{\mathcal O}:L_{\mathcal O}]\,R\bigr)T_{\mathcal O}.
\]
Indeed, each multiplicity \([P_{\mathcal O}:j(B')]\) is divisible
by \([P_{\mathcal O}:L_{\mathcal O}]\), and taking
\(j(B')=L_{\mathcal O}\) realizes that index. The sum runs over all
orbits, including those on which no left diagram is nonzero. Over
\(\mathbb Z\), the quotient by this span is therefore the direct
sum of the groups \(\mathbb Z/[P_{\mathcal O}:L_{\mathcal O}]\mathbb Z\).
The coefficient-one expansion of a left diagram also holds over
\(R\), since the coefficient count uses only the basis sets.
article.locator: Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, Other coefficient rings, p. 40

items.title: An orbit coefficient vanishing in characteristic three

article.statement:
Take all six boundary groups equal to
\(S_3\), the identity embeddings, and right dots \((1,(123),1)\)
with \(B'=1\). The individual projections are both \(S_3\),
while the pair stabilizer projects to \(\langle(123)\rangle\).
On the two bases identified with \(S_3\), the map sends
\(x\) to \(3x((123)+(132))\), since each conjugate of \((123)\)
is counted three times. Over a ring of characteristic \(3\), every
right diagram has zero coefficient on this orbit.
article.locator: Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 8.5 [ex:case-six-characteristic-three], p. 42

items.title: A Case 6 obstruction with trivial projected stabilizers

article.statement:
Take
\[
 G=A=C=\langle(12),(34)\rangle,\qquad
 D=E=\operatorname{Sym}(\{1,2,3,4\}),\qquad F=1
\]
with inclusion embeddings. The two boundary bases identify with
\(D\) by multiplication. The right diagram with \(B'=1\) and unit
dots fixes the basis elements of \(A\) and sends those in
\(D\setminus A\) to zero by (6.4).

Consider any left diagram with group-element dots \(r,t,s\) and
embeddings \(u,v,w\) as in Lemma~6.6.
Its lower and upper vertex conditions give
\[
 u(G)\le r v(D)r^{-1},\qquad u(G)\le s w(E)s^{-1}.
\]
The image \(u(G)\) moves four points. Both displayed overgroups are
full symmetric groups on four points, so they are the same subgroup.
Use \([1,x]_A\) and \([1,y]_C\) for the input and output.
The left-diagram equation becomes
\[
 s w(y)s^{-1}=(r v(x)r^{-1})(rts^{-1}).
\]
If \(rts^{-1}\) belongs to the common subgroup, every input has
exactly one output. Otherwise every input has zero outputs.
By linearity, the sum of the output coefficients of any finite
sum of left diagrams is constant on basis inputs. The right
diagram has coefficient sum \(1\) on \(A\) and \(0\) off \(A\),
so it has no left replacement.
article.locator: Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 8.6 [ex:case-six-trivial-stabilizers], p. 42

article.statement:

with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the

Graph. The first cluster treats general noncommutative-ring Eilenberg–Watts via the regular module, the balanced comparison, a free presentation and evaluation of natural transformations. Keep compatible scalar actions in the complex-linear specialization. The remaining clusters use typed generators, Mackey finite-fiber formulas and direct-sum identities, scalar curls and dot slides, the two parallel and two mixed crossing orders, the all-induction move and Cases 1–6, finite-parabolic block operations and contingency data, and the finite-parabolic moves. The Alphabeta items provide the noncommutative tensor universal property, the categorical presentation argument and ambient associator, unitors and coherence. Restrict the bicategory after showing closure using the middle-group Mackey formula and the transported embeddings. Finite sums and coefficient choices retain the paper's assumptions.

Local connection. MackeyDiagrams.Embedding defines ConjEmbedding as a homomorphism with existence of a conjugating representative. Its equality criterion requires two conjugators and both image-containment predicates. For the article's linearly extended equality/coset statement, relate monoid-algebra basis coefficients to equality of the underlying homomorphisms. MackeyDiagrams.Dot stores a particular element of G and the pointwise intertwining equation. Its inverse and vertical composition preserve the typed embeddings. The full dot criterion also connects any admissible dot to representatives of the two cosets and the evaluated basis maps. The existing balanced quotient proves balancing by group elements. MackeyDiagrams.Balanced already proves liftBalanced, liftBalanced_pairLinear and liftBalanced_unique for an R-bilinear map satisfying IsBalanced under the diagonal H action. Use that universal property and extend balance from group elements to the middle group algebra while carrying the two exterior actions. Diagram.eval composes vertical maps. Its evaluationSetoid compares maps at a fixed bottom and top Word. Preserve both syntax terms, with explicit reassociation, unitors and boundary transports where needed.

Carry the finite-fiber predicate of the mixed crossing separately so that Mackey projections and infinite-index crossings have finite surviving support. Build an algebraic direct sum or a sum pointwise finite on each input in the Mackey and Case 5 identities. Fiber finiteness yields finitely many orbit contributions at each input even when the set of orbits is infinite. Keep arbitrary groups until the finite parabolic specialization. Implement the finite-parabolic carrier as the finitely supported permutation subgroup of permutations of Nat and use Finite instances on each finite block as needed. Cases 1–2 use two projections with additional intermediate finite indices where specified. Cases 3–4 compare the push maps of two actual multiplication composites. Normalization over C uses nonzero finite indices. Repository search and compatibility. Mathlib is the Lean community's maintained foundational library. The exact source files and LICENSE matched pinned GitHub raw sources. Commit 65d730f7150f21fdfa32f3e73a3f549c1f96a0e9 is Apache-2.0 and uses leanprover/lean4:v4.36.0-rc2. Each ledger declaration has a checked type below its usage and a pinned source permalink. Induction is defined for arbitrary group homomorphisms over a commutative ring. The right adjunction is for a subgroup inclusion with a decidable right coset relation and a finite-index instance. Classical decidability and transport through the image subgroup allow its use here. Both categorical adjunctions require a comparison of their unit and counit with the typed project maps. No complete Eilenberg–Watts theorem for general noncommutative rings, Mackey diagram decomposition, or ready-made finite-parabolic tableau and six-direction move theorem was identified in the pinned source. ModuleCat.freeDesc uses the same universe for the free generator type and module, so fix that presentation universe or use explicit lifts. The transposition-closure results on arbitrary decidable-equality carriers apply to actual permutations of Nat via finite set-support.

∀ {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (X : ι → Finset Nat),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (X i)) →
  Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (X i) (X j)) →
  ∀ α : ↥(Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}),
    let blockProduct : (ι → Finset Nat) → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
      fun blocks => iSup (fun i =>
        MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ blocks i)))
    Subgroup.map
        (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (α : Equiv.Perm Nat)))
        (blockProduct X) =
      blockProduct (fun i => Finset.image (α : Equiv.Perm Nat) (X i))

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  Kα ≤ G → Hβ ≤ G →
  let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
  let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
  let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
    let L := fun j : J =>
      Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
    let C := fun j : J =>
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))) (L j)
    ∀ (I : J → Type*) (hRep : ∀ j : J, I j → H)
      (_ : ∀ (j : J) (h : H), ∃! u : I j, (h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ ∈ C j)
      (j : J) (g : G),
      let surviving : Set (I j) :=
        {u | α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹ * α ∈ K}
      (DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j → ∃! u : I j, u ∈ surviving) ∧
        (DoubleCoset.mk A B g ≠ j → surviving = ∅)

FiniteParabolicIntersectionBlocks.type:
∀ {ι κ : Type*} [Finite ι] [Finite κ] (X : Finset Nat)
    (A : ι → Finset Nat) (B : κ → Finset Nat),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (A i)) →
  (∀ j, Finset.Nonempty (B j)) →
  Pairwise (fun i i' => Disjoint (A i) (A i')) →
  Pairwise (fun j j' => Disjoint (B j) (B j')) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ A i) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ j, n ∈ B j) →
  let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
    fun S => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
  (iSup (fun i => blockSym (A i))) ⊓ (iSup (fun j => blockSym (B j))) =
    iSup (fun i => iSup (fun j => blockSym (A i ∩ B j)))

ModuleTensorUniversalProperty.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (M : Type v) (N : Type w) [Ring R]
  [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module (MulOpposite R) M] [Module R N],
  let F := Finsupp (Prod M N) Int
  let gen : Prod M N → F := fun p => Finsupp.single p 1
  let H : AddSubgroup F := AddSubgroup.closure
    { x | (∃ (m m' : M) (n : N),
        x = gen (m + m', n) - gen (m, n) - gen (m', n)) ∨
      (∃ (m : M) (n n' : N),
        x = gen (m, n + n') - gen (m, n) - gen (m, n')) ∨
      (∃ (r : R) (m : M) (n : N),
        x = gen (MulOpposite.op r • m, n) - gen (m, r • n)) }
  let T := HasQuotient.Quotient F H
  let τ : Prod M N → T := fun p => QuotientAddGroup.mk' H (gen p)
  ((∀ (m m' : M) (n : N), τ (m + m', n) = τ (m, n) + τ (m', n)) ∧
    (∀ (m : M) (n n' : N), τ (m, n + n') = τ (m, n) + τ (m, n')) ∧
    (∀ (r : R) (m : M) (n : N), τ (MulOpposite.op r • m, n) = τ (m, r • n))) ∧
  (∀ (A : Type z) [AddCommGroup A],
    let Bal := { b : Prod M N → A //
      (∀ (m m' : M) (n : N), b (m + m', n) = b (m, n) + b (m', n)) ∧
      (∀ (m : M) (n n' : N), b (m, n + n') = b (m, n) + b (m, n')) ∧
      (∀ (r : R) (m : M) (n : N), b (MulOpposite.op r • m, n) = b (m, r • n)) }
    (∀ b : Bal, ∃! lift : AddMonoidHom T A, ∀ m n, lift (τ (m, n)) = b.val (m, n)) ∧
    (∃ e : Equiv (AddMonoidHom T A) Bal, ∀ f p, (e f).val p = f (τ p)))

NaturalTransformationsOfTensorFunctors.type:
∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [Ring A] [Ring B],
  let Bimod := Sigma (fun M : ModuleCat.{w} B =>
    { D : Bimodule.1 B A M // D.1 = (inferInstance : Module B M) })
  let right := fun (M : Bimod) (m : M.1) (a : A) =>
    letI : Module (MulOpposite A) M.1 := M.2.1.2.1
    MulOpposite.op a • m
  let AMod := ModuleCat.{max u x} A
  let BMod := ModuleCat.{max u w x} B
  let regular := ModuleCat.of A (ULift.{x} A)
  let Balanced := fun (M : Bimod) (X : AMod) (Y : BMod)
      (p : ↥M.1 → X → Y) =>
    (∀ m n : ↥M.1, ∀ a : X, p (m + n) a = p m a + p n a) ∧
    (∀ m : ↥M.1, ∀ a b : X, p m (a + b) = p m a + p m b) ∧
    (∀ b : B, ∀ m : ↥M.1, ∀ a : X, p (b • m) a = b • p m a) ∧
    (∀ a : A, ∀ m : ↥M.1, ∀ y : X, p (right M m a) y = p m (a • y))
  let TensorFunctor := fun M : Bimod =>
    {D : Sigma (fun F : CategoryTheory.Functor AMod BMod =>
          ∀ X : AMod, ↥M.1 → X → F.obj X) //
      (∀ X : AMod, Balanced M X (D.1.obj X) (D.2 X)) ∧
      (∀ (X : AMod) (Y : BMod) (p : ↥M.1 → X → Y),
        Balanced M X Y p →
          ∃! k : LinearMap (RingHom.id B) (D.1.obj X) Y,
            ∀ (m : ↥M.1) (y : X), k (D.2 X m y) = p m y) ∧
      (∀ (X Y : AMod) (h : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) (m : ↥M.1) (y : X),
        (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (D.1.map h)) (D.2 X m y) = D.2 Y m ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom h) y))}
  let Hom := fun (M N : Bimod) =>
    {f : LinearMap (RingHom.id B) M.1 N.1 //
      ∀ (m : ↥M.1) (a : A), f (right M m a) = right N (f m) a}
  let NatCode := Hom
  let Unitor := fun (M : Bimod) (T : TensorFunctor M) =>
    LinearEquiv (RingHom.id B) (T.1.1.obj regular) M.1
  let IsUnitor := fun (M : Bimod) (T : TensorFunctor M) (rho : Unitor M T) =>
    (∀ (m : ↥M.1) (a : A), rho (T.1.2 regular m (ULift.up a)) = right M m a) ∧
    (∀ m : ↥M.1, rho.symm m = T.1.2 regular m (ULift.up (1 : A)))
  let eval := fun (M N : Bimod) (T : TensorFunctor M) (S : TensorFunctor N)
      (rho : Unitor M T) (sigma : Unitor N S) (eta : CategoryTheory.NatTrans T.1.1 S.1.1) =>
    LinearMap.comp sigma.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.comp (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (eta.app regular)) rho.symm.toLinearMap)
  let Represents := fun (M N : Bimod) (T : TensorFunctor M) (S : TensorFunctor N)
      (rho : Unitor M T) (sigma : Unitor N S)
      (eta : CategoryTheory.NatTrans T.1.1 S.1.1) (f : NatCode M N) =>
    f.1 = eval M N T S rho sigma eta ∧
    (∀ m : ↥M.1, f.1 m =
      sigma ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom (eta.app regular)) (T.1.2 regular m (ULift.up (1 : A))))) ∧
    (∀ (X : AMod) (m : ↥M.1) (y : X),
      (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (eta.app X)) (T.1.2 X m y) = S.1.2 X (f.1 m) y)
  let InverseAssignments := fun (M N : Bimod) (T : TensorFunctor M) (S : TensorFunctor N)
      (rho : Unitor M T) (sigma : Unitor N S) =>
    (∀ eta : CategoryTheory.NatTrans T.1.1 S.1.1, ∃! f : NatCode M N, Represents M N T S rho sigma eta f) ∧
    (∀ f : NatCode M N, ∃! eta : CategoryTheory.NatTrans T.1.1 S.1.1, Represents M N T S rho sigma eta f)
  ∀ (M N P : Bimod) (T : TensorFunctor M) (S : TensorFunctor N) (U : TensorFunctor P),
    ∃ (rho : Unitor M T) (sigma : Unitor N S) (tau : Unitor P U),
      IsUnitor M T rho ∧ IsUnitor N S sigma ∧ IsUnitor P U tau ∧
      InverseAssignments M N T S rho sigma ∧
      InverseAssignments N P S U sigma tau ∧
      InverseAssignments M P T U rho tau ∧
      (∀ eta theta : CategoryTheory.NatTrans T.1.1 S.1.1,
        ∃ sum : CategoryTheory.NatTrans T.1.1 S.1.1,
          (∀ X : AMod, ModuleCat.Hom.hom (sum.app X) =
            ModuleCat.Hom.hom (eta.app X) + ModuleCat.Hom.hom (theta.app X)) ∧
          eval M N T S rho sigma sum =
            eval M N T S rho sigma eta + eval M N T S rho sigma theta) ∧
      (∃ identity : CategoryTheory.NatTrans T.1.1 T.1.1,
        (∀ X : AMod, ModuleCat.Hom.hom (identity.app X) = LinearMap.id) ∧
        eval M M T T rho rho identity = LinearMap.id) ∧
      (∀ (eta : CategoryTheory.NatTrans T.1.1 S.1.1) (theta : CategoryTheory.NatTrans S.1.1 U.1.1),
        ∃ composite : CategoryTheory.NatTrans T.1.1 U.1.1,
          (∀ X : AMod, ModuleCat.Hom.hom (composite.app X) =
            LinearMap.comp (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (theta.app X)) (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (eta.app X))) ∧
          eval M P T U rho tau composite =
            LinearMap.comp (eval N P S U sigma tau theta) (eval M N T S rho sigma eta))

BalancedTensorAssociativity.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [Ring R] [Ring S],
  let Middle := Sigma (fun N : ModuleCat.{x} R =>
    { right : Module (MulOpposite S) N //
      letI := right
      SMulCommClass (MulOpposite S) R N })
  let Triple := Prod (ModuleCat.{w} (MulOpposite R)) (Prod Middle (ModuleCat.{y} S))
  let first := fun (X : Triple) => X.1
  let middle := fun (X : Triple) => X.2.1.1
  let last := fun (X : Triple) => X.2.2
  let rightMiddle := fun (X : Triple) => X.2.1.2.val
  let innerLeft := fun (X : Triple) =>
    let M := first X
    let N := middle X
    let F := Finsupp (Prod M N) Int
    let gen : M → N → F := fun a b => Finsupp.single (a, b) 1
    let H : AddSubgroup F := AddSubgroup.closure
      { z | (∃ (a a' : M) (b : N),
              z = gen (a + a') b - gen a b - gen a' b) ∨
            (∃ (a : M) (b b' : N),
              z = gen a (b + b') - gen a b - gen a b') ∨
            (∃ (r : R) (a : M) (b : N),
              z = gen (MulOpposite.op r • a) b - gen a (r • b)) }
    (⟨H, fun m n => QuotientAddGroup.mk' H (gen m n)⟩ :
      Sigma (fun K : AddSubgroup F => M → N → HasQuotient.Quotient F K))
  let innerRight := fun (X : Triple) =>
    let N := middle X
    let P := last X
    letI := rightMiddle X
    let F := Finsupp (Prod N P) Int
    let gen : N → P → F := fun a b => Finsupp.single (a, b) 1
    let H : AddSubgroup F := AddSubgroup.closure
      { z | (∃ (a a' : N) (b : P),
              z = gen (a + a') b - gen a b - gen a' b) ∨
            (∃ (a : N) (b b' : P),
              z = gen a (b + b') - gen a b - gen a b') ∨
            (∃ (r : S) (a : N) (b : P),
              z = gen (MulOpposite.op r • a) b - gen a (r • b)) }
    (⟨H, fun n p => QuotientAddGroup.mk' H (gen n p)⟩ :
      Sigma (fun K : AddSubgroup F => N → P → HasQuotient.Quotient F K))
  let MN := fun (X : Triple) =>
    HasQuotient.Quotient (Finsupp (Prod (first X) (middle X)) Int) (innerLeft X).1
  let NP := fun (X : Triple) =>
    HasQuotient.Quotient (Finsupp (Prod (middle X) (last X)) Int) (innerRight X).1
  let InnerActions := fun (X : Triple) =>
    { a : Prod (Module (MulOpposite S) (MN X)) (Module R (NP X)) //
      (∀ (s : S) (m : first X) (n : middle X),
        a.1.smul (MulOpposite.op s) ((innerLeft X).2 m n) =
          (innerLeft X).2 m ((rightMiddle X).smul (MulOpposite.op s) n)) ∧
      (∀ (r : R) (n : middle X) (p : last X),
        a.2.smul r ((innerRight X).2 n p) = (innerRight X).2 (r • n) p) }
  let Parenthesized := Sigma InnerActions
  let left := fun (X : Parenthesized) =>
    let M := first X.1
    let N := middle X.1
    let P := last X.1
    let A := MN X.1
    letI := X.2.val.1
    let F := Finsupp (Prod A P) Int
    let gen : A → P → F := fun a b => Finsupp.single (a, b) 1
    let H : AddSubgroup F := AddSubgroup.closure
      { z | (∃ (a a' : A) (b : P),
              z = gen (a + a') b - gen a b - gen a' b) ∨
            (∃ (a : A) (b b' : P),
              z = gen a (b + b') - gen a b - gen a b') ∨
            (∃ (r : S) (a : A) (b : P),
              z = gen (MulOpposite.op r • a) b - gen a (r • b)) }
    (⟨H, fun m n p => QuotientAddGroup.mk' H (gen ((innerLeft X.1).2 m n) p)⟩ :
      Sigma (fun K : AddSubgroup F => M → N → P → HasQuotient.Quotient F K))
  let right := fun (X : Parenthesized) =>
    let M := first X.1
    let N := middle X.1
    let P := last X.1
    let B := NP X.1
    letI := X.2.val.2
    let F := Finsupp (Prod M B) Int
    let gen : M → B → F := fun a b => Finsupp.single (a, b) 1
    let H : AddSubgroup F := AddSubgroup.closure
      { z | (∃ (a a' : M) (b : B),
              z = gen (a + a') b - gen a b - gen a' b) ∨
            (∃ (a : M) (b b' : B),
              z = gen a (b + b') - gen a b - gen a b') ∨
            (∃ (r : R) (a : M) (b : B),
              z = gen (MulOpposite.op r • a) b - gen a (r • b)) }
    (⟨H, fun m n p => QuotientAddGroup.mk' H (gen m ((innerRight X.1).2 n p))⟩ :
      Sigma (fun K : AddSubgroup F => M → N → P → HasQuotient.Quotient F K))
  let L := fun (X : Parenthesized) =>
    HasQuotient.Quotient (Finsupp (Prod (MN X.1) (last X.1)) Int) (left X).1
  let T := fun (X : Parenthesized) =>
    HasQuotient.Quotient (Finsupp (Prod (first X.1) (NP X.1)) Int) (right X).1
  let tL := fun (X : Parenthesized) => (left X).2
  let tT := fun (X : Parenthesized) => (right X).2
  (∀ X : Triple, Nonempty (InnerActions X)) ∧
  (∃ α : ∀ X : Parenthesized, AddEquiv (L X) (T X),
    (∀ (X : Parenthesized) (e : AddEquiv (L X) (T X)),
      (∀ (m : first X.1) (n : middle X.1) (p : last X.1),
        e (tL X m n p) = tT X m n p) ↔ e = α X) ∧
    (∀ (X : Parenthesized) (C : Type z) [Ring C] [Module C (first X.1)]
        [SMulCommClass C (MulOpposite R) (first X.1)],
      ∃ (aL : Module C (L X)) (aT : Module C (T X)),
        (∀ (c : C) (m : first X.1) (n : middle X.1) (p : last X.1),
          aL.smul c (tL X m n p) = tL X (c • m) n p ∧
          aT.smul c (tT X m n p) = tT X (c • m) n p) ∧
        (∀ (c : C) (q : L X), α X (aL.smul c q) = aT.smul c (α X q))) ∧
    (∀ (X : Parenthesized) (D : Type t) [Ring D] [Module (MulOpposite D) (last X.1)]
        [SMulCommClass S (MulOpposite D) (last X.1)],
      ∃ (aL : Module (MulOpposite D) (L X)) (aT : Module (MulOpposite D) (T X)),
        (∀ (d : D) (m : first X.1) (n : middle X.1) (p : last X.1),
          aL.smul (MulOpposite.op d) (tL X m n p) = tL X m n (MulOpposite.op d • p) ∧
          aT.smul (MulOpposite.op d) (tT X m n p) = tT X m n (MulOpposite.op d • p)) ∧
        (∀ (d : D) (q : L X),
          α X (aL.smul (MulOpposite.op d) q) = aT.smul (MulOpposite.op d) (α X q))) ∧
    (∀ (X Y : Parenthesized)
        (f : LinearMap (RingHom.id (MulOpposite R)) (first X.1) (first Y.1))
        (g : LinearMap (RingHom.id R) (middle X.1) (middle Y.1))
        (h : LinearMap (RingHom.id S) (last X.1) (last Y.1)),
      (∀ (s : S) (n : middle X.1),
        g ((rightMiddle X.1).smul (MulOpposite.op s) n) =
          (rightMiddle Y.1).smul (MulOpposite.op s) (g n)) →

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (L H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ l : L, β * (l : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H),
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let ab := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b
  let φ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom
  let upA := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let upB := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
  let downA := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
  let downB := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down b
  let upPair := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex upA.basis upB.basis
  let downPair := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex downB.basis downA.basis
  let upMerge := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b
  let upSplit := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) a b
  let downMerge := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown (R := Complex) a b
  let downSplit := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) a b
  (∀ l : L, (ab.toHom l : U) = (α * β) * (l : U) * (α * β)⁻¹) ∧
  (∀ (x : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) (y : MonoidAlgebra Complex H),
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval upMerge).toLinearMap
      (upPair (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y)) =
      MonoidAlgebra.coeff (x * φ y) ∧
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval downMerge).toLinearMap
      (downPair (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x)) =
      MonoidAlgebra.coeff (φ y * x)) ∧
  (∀ z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G,
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval upSplit).toLinearMap (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z) =
      upPair (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex H)) ∧
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval downSplit).toLinearMap (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z) =
      downPair (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex H)) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z)) ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical upMerge upSplit) =
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upA upB)) ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical upSplit upMerge) =
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ab)) ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical downMerge downSplit) =
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downB downA)) ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical downSplit downMerge) =
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down ab))

  [CategoryTheory.Functor.Additive F],
  let FX := CategoryTheory.Functor.obj F
  let Fmap := fun (X Y : ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (f : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) =>
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map F f
  let compA : ∀ {X Y Z : ModuleCat.{max u z} A},
      ModuleCat.Hom X Y → ModuleCat.Hom Y Z → ModuleCat.Hom X Z :=
    fun {X Y Z} f g => @CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (ModuleCat.{max u z} A) _ X Y Z f g
  let compB : ∀ {X Y Z : ModuleCat.{w} B},
      ModuleCat.Hom X Y → ModuleCat.Hom Y Z → ModuleCat.Hom X Z :=
    fun {X Y Z} f g => @CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (ModuleCat.{w} B) _ X Y Z f g
  (∀ (X Y Q : ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (f : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) (q : ModuleCat.Hom Y Q),
    compA f q = ModuleCat.ofHom 0 →
    Nonempty (∀ (Z : ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (g : ModuleCat.Hom Y Z),
      compA f g = ModuleCat.ofHom 0 →
      Unique {d : ModuleCat.Hom Q Z // compA q d = g}) →
    (compB (Fmap X Y f) (Fmap Y Q q) = ModuleCat.ofHom 0 ∧
      Nonempty (∀ (Z : ModuleCat.{w} B) (g : ModuleCat.Hom (FX Y) Z),
        compB (Fmap X Y f) g = ModuleCat.ofHom 0 →
        Unique {d : ModuleCat.Hom (FX Q) Z //
          compB (Fmap Y Q q) d = g}))) →
  (∀ (I : Type (max u z)) (D : I → ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (P : ModuleCat.{max u z} A)
    (ι : ∀ i, ModuleCat.Hom (D i) P),
    Nonempty (∀ (Q : ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (legs : ∀ i, ModuleCat.Hom (D i) Q),
      Unique {d : ModuleCat.Hom P Q //
        ∀ i : I, compA (ι i) d = legs i}) →
    Nonempty (∀ (Q : ModuleCat.{w} B) (legs : ∀ i, ModuleCat.Hom (FX (D i)) Q),
      Unique {d : ModuleCat.Hom (FX P) Q //

  let regular := ModuleCat.of A (ULift.{z} A)

  let right : A → M → M := fun a m =>
    ModuleCat.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.Functor.map F
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearEquiv.conjRingEquiv (LinearEquiv.symm down)
        (LinearMap.mulRight A a)))) m

    fun _X x => ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.smulRight (LinearEquiv.toLinearMap down) x)

    fun X m x => ModuleCat.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.Functor.map F (ell X x)) m
  let Free := fun (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A) => FreeAddGroup (Prod M X)
  let gen : ∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A), M → X → Free X :=
    fun _X m x => FreeAddGroup.of (m, x)
  let rel : ∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A), Free X → Free X → Prop := fun X p q =>
    (∃ a b : Free X, p = a + b ∧ q = b + a) ∨
    (∃ (m m' : M) (x : X), p = gen X (m + m') x ∧ q = gen X m x + gen X m' x) ∨
    (∃ (m : M) (x x' : X), p = gen X m (x + x') ∧ q = gen X m x + gen X m x') ∨
    (∃ (a : A) (m : M) (x : X), p = gen X (right a m) x ∧ q = gen X m (a • x))
  let relations : ∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A), AddCon (Free X) :=
    fun X => addConGen (rel X)
  let Tensor := fun X => AddCon.Quotient (relations X)
  let tensorAddCommGroup : ∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A), AddCommGroup (Tensor X) := fun X =>
    { AddCon.addGroup (relations X) with
      add_comm := fun p q =>
        AddCon.induction_on₂ p q fun a b =>
          (AddCon.eq (relations X)).2
            (AddConGen.Rel.of (a + b) (b + a) (Or.inl ⟨a, b, rfl, rfl⟩)) }
  let pure : ∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A), M → X → Tensor X :=
    fun X m x => @AddCon.toQuotient _ _ (relations X) (gen X m x)
  letI : ∀ X, AddCommGroup (Tensor X) := tensorAddCommGroup
  ∃ (tensorModule : ∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A), Module B (Tensor X)),
  let obj : ModuleCat.{max u z} A → ModuleCat.{max u z w} B := fun X =>
    @ModuleCat.of B _ (Tensor X) (tensorAddCommGroup X)
      (tensorModule X)
  ∃ (map : ∀ {X Y : ModuleCat.{max u z} A}, ModuleCat.Hom X Y → ModuleCat.Hom (obj X) (obj Y))
    (mapId : ∀ X, @map X X (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X) =
      CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (obj X))
    (mapComp : ∀ {X Y Z : ModuleCat.{max u z} A} (f : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) (g : ModuleCat.Hom Y Z),
      @map X Z (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp _ _ X Y Z f g) =
        @CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp _ _ (obj X) (obj Y) (obj Z)
          (@map X Y f) (@map Y Z g)),

      CategoryTheory.Functor.mk obj (@map) mapId (@mapComp)

    let liftedF : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (ModuleCat.{max u z w} B) :=
      { obj := fun X => CategoryTheory.Functor.obj liftTarget (FX X)
        map := fun f => CategoryTheory.Functor.map liftTarget (CategoryTheory.Functor.map F f)
        map_id := fun X =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun f => CategoryTheory.Functor.map liftTarget f)
              (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id F X))
            (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id liftTarget (FX X))
        map_comp := fun {_ _ _} f g =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun h => CategoryTheory.Functor.map liftTarget h)
              (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp F f g))
            (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp liftTarget
              (CategoryTheory.Functor.map F f) (CategoryTheory.Functor.map F g)) }
    ∃ tau : CategoryTheory.NatTrans T liftedF,
      (∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (b : B) (m : M) (x : X),
        letI : Module B (Tensor X) := tensorModule X
        b • pure X m x = pure X (b • m) x) ∧
      (∀ (X Y : ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (f : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) (m : M) (x : X),
        ModuleCat.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.Functor.map T f) (pure X m x) =
          pure Y m (ModuleCat.Hom.hom f x)) ∧
      (∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A),
        letI : Module B (Tensor X) := tensorModule X
        let tauX : LinearMap (RingHom.id B) (Tensor X) (FX X) := LinearMap.comp
          (LinearEquiv.toLinearMap (ULift.moduleEquiv :
            LinearEquiv (RingHom.id B) (ULift.{max u z} (FX X)) (FX X)))
          (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app tau X))
        (∀ (m : M) (x : X), tauX (pure X m x) = beta X m x) ∧
        (∀ h : AddMonoidHom (Tensor X) (FX X),
          (∀ (m : M) (x : X), h (pure X m x) = beta X m x) →
            h = LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom tauX)) ∧
      (∃ inverse : CategoryTheory.NatTrans liftedF T,
        ∀ X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A,
          let tauX := CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app tau X
          let invX := CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app inverse X
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp tauX invX =
            CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj T X) ∧
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp invX tauX =
            CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj liftedF X))

    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let A := MonoidAlgebra Complex H

    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex down.basis up.basis
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y)

    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex up.basis down.basis
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y)

        (MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceBasis Complex a))
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).toLinearMap)

    ∃ h : H, (h : U) = α⁻¹ * (g : U) * α ∧ E (basisG g) = MonoidAlgebra.single h 1) ∧

    let cup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval

    let IsTransversal := fun T : Finset G =>
      ∀ g : G, ∃! t : {t : G // t ∈ T}, g * t.val⁻¹ ∈ S
    let toRep : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (Rep.{max u v} Complex H) :=
      Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra

      CategoryTheory.Functor.comp

        (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := G))

        ModuleCat.Hom.hom (adj.counit.app X) (show Res.obj (Ind.obj X) from pure X (x * y) z) =

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G L : Subgroup U) (α β a b : U)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (ha : ∀ ℓ : L, a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹ ∈ K)
    (hb : ∀ ℓ : L, b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hs : (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let ea := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator a ha
  let eb := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator b hb
  let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (eα.comp ea) (eβ.comp eb) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * a) (β * b)
      (by
        intro ℓ
        change α * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
        simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
      (by
        intro ℓ
        change β * (b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
        simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]) hs
  let s := d.element
  let A := eα.toHom.range
  let B := eβ.toHom.range
  let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
    let j := DoubleCoset.mk A B s
    let orbit := DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    let Ls := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K ⊓
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((s : U) * β))) H
    let Limage := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (α * a))) L
    let finiteIndex := Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex Limage Ls
    let n := Subgroup.relIndex Limage Ls
    let X := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction ea
    let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction eb
    let qBasis := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ ea eb d
    let q := fun w : (X.tensor Y).carrier =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ (qBasis w)
    let fiber := fun g : G => {w | q w = g}
    let ι := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) eα eβ ea eb d
    let finiteFibers := ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | qBasis w = z}
    let traceArg := fun (g : G) (t : H) => g * (eβ.toHom t)⁻¹ * s⁻¹
    let survives := fun (T : Set H) (g : G) => {t | t ∈ T ∧ traceArg g t ∈ A}
    let rightTransversal := fun T : Set H =>
      ∀ h : H, ∃! t : H, t ∈ T ∧ h * t⁻¹ ∈ eb.toHom.range
    Limage ≤ Ls ∧
    (∀ (k : K) (h : H), q (X.pair Y k h) = eα.toHom k * s * eβ.toHom h) ∧
    (∀ w : (X.tensor Y).carrier,
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval ι).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single w 1) =
        Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ (q w)) 1) ∧
    Set.range q = orbit ∧
    (∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit → finiteIndex → Nat.card (fiber g) = n) ∧
    (finiteFibers ↔ finiteIndex) ∧
    (∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit → ¬ finiteIndex → Set.Infinite (fiber g)) ∧
    ((∀ h : H, Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.multiplicationCapBasis eb w = h}) ↔
      Subgroup.FiniteIndex eb.toHom.range) ∧
    (∀ (T : Set H), rightTransversal T → ∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit → ¬ finiteIndex →
      Set.Infinite (survives T g)) ∧
    (∀ hf : finiteFibers,
      let p := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) eα eβ ea eb d hf
      let evalOnBasis := fun g : G =>
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval p).toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) 1)
      (∀ g : G, evalOnBasis g = Finset.sum
        (hf (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g)).toFinset
        (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1)) ∧
      (∀ (T : Set H), rightTransversal T → ∀ g : G,
        ∃ ht : Set.Finite (survives T g), evalOnBasis g = Finset.sum ht.toFinset
          (fun t => MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y
            (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceBasis Complex eα (traceArg g t))
            (Finsupp.single t 1))))

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (H G : Subgroup U) (α : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let A := MonoidAlgebra Complex H
  let B := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let S := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let φ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
  let traceCap := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap (R := Complex) a
  let cap := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval traceCap
  let pairDI := fun (x y : B) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex down.basis up.basis
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y)
  let pairID := fun (x y : B) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex up.basis down.basis
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y)
  let basisG := fun g : G => MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex)
  let E : LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) B A :=
    LinearMap.comp (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.comp
        (MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceBasis Complex a))
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).toLinearMap)
  (∀ g : G, g ∈ S →
    ∃ h : H, (h : U) = α⁻¹ * (g : U) * α ∧ E (basisG g) = MonoidAlgebra.single h 1) ∧
  (∀ g : G, g ∉ S → E (basisG g) = 0) ∧
  (∀ (r s : A) (x : B), E (φ r * x * φ s) = r * E x * s) ∧
  (∀ x y : B, cap.toLinearMap (pairDI x y) = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (E (x * y))) ∧
  (∀ finite : Subgroup.FiniteIndex S,
    let reverseCup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup (R := Complex) a finite
    let cup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval reverseCup
    let IsTransversal := fun T : Finset G =>
      ∀ g : G, ∃! t : {t : G // t ∈ T}, g * t.val⁻¹ ∈ S
    let toRep : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (Rep.{max u v} Complex H) :=
      Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra
    let Ind : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (ModuleCat.{max u v} B) :=
      CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp toRep (Rep.indFunctor Complex a.toHom))
        (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := G))
    let Res : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} B) (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) :=
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ.toRingHom

      let ρ := Rep.ρ (toRep.obj X)

        (Representation.asModuleEquiv (Representation.ind a.toHom ρ)).symm
          (MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex
            (fun g : G => Representation.IndV.mk a.toHom ρ g⁻¹ x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff b))

    (∀ (T : Finset G), IsTransversal T →
      let leftTerm := fun (t : G) (x : B) => basisG (t⁻¹) * φ (E (basisG t * x))
      let rightTerm := fun (t : G) (x : B) => φ (E (x * basisG (t⁻¹))) * basisG t

        Finset.sum T (fun t => rightTerm t x) = x) ∧
      (∀ g : G,
        (∃! t : {t : G // t ∈ T}, leftTerm t.val (basisG g) ≠ 0) ∧
        (∃! t : {t : G // t ∈ T}, rightTerm t.val (basisG g) ≠ 0))) ∧
    (let idUp := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) up
     let idDown := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) down

       MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
         (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit down)
         (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
           (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDown reverseCup)
           (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
             (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate down up down)
             (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
               (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal traceCap idDown)
               (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit down))))
     let triangleUp :=
       MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
         (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit up)
         (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
           (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal reverseCup idUp)
           (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
             (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate up down up)
             (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
               (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUp traceCap)
               (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit up))))

       MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval triangleUp = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval idUp) ∧

      (∀ Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} B,
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Res.map (adj.unit.app Y))
          (adj.counit.app (Res.obj Y)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (Res.obj Y)) ∧
      (∀ X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A,
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (adj.unit.app (Ind.obj X))
          (Ind.map (adj.counit.app X)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (Ind.obj X)) ∧
      (∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (x y : B) (z : X),

        (∀ g : G,
          cup.toLinearMap (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (basisG g)) =
            Finset.sum T (fun t => pairID (basisG (g * t⁻¹)) (basisG t)) ∧

            Finset.sum T (fun t => pairID (basisG (t⁻¹)) (basisG (t * g)))) ∧
        (∀ (Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} B) (g : G) (z : Y),
          ModuleCat.Hom.hom (adj.unit.app Y) (basisG g • z) =
            Finset.sum T (fun t =>
              pure (Res.obj Y) (basisG (g * t⁻¹)) (basisG t • z)))))

let Mod := fun A : RingCat.{u} => ModuleCat.{max u v} A
let Actions := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) (M : Mod S) =>
  { d : Bimodule.1 S R M // d.1 = ModuleCat.isModule M }
let Bimod := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) => Sigma (Actions S R)
let right := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) (M : Bimod S R) (m : M.1) (r : R) =>
  letI : Module (MulOpposite R) M.1 := M.2.1.2.1
  MulOpposite.op r • m
let Hom := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) (M N : Bimod S R) =>
  { f : LinearMap (RingHom.id S) M.1 N.1 //
    ∀ (m : M.1) (r : R), f (right S R M m r) = right S R N (f m) r }
letI : ∀ S R : RingCat.{u}, CategoryTheory.Category (Bimod S R) := fun S R =>
  { Hom := Hom S R
    id := fun _ => ⟨LinearMap.id, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
    comp := fun f g =>
      ⟨LinearMap.comp g.val f.val, fun m r =>
        Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => g.val x) (f.property m r))
          (g.property (f.val m) r)⟩
    id_comp := fun _ => Subtype.ext (LinearMap.id_comp _)
    comp_id := fun _ => Subtype.ext (LinearMap.comp_id _)
    assoc := fun _ _ _ => Subtype.ext (LinearMap.comp_assoc _ _ _) }
let forgetBimod : ∀ S R : RingCat.{u}, CategoryTheory.Functor (Bimod S R) (Mod S) :=
  fun _ _ =>
    { obj := fun M => M.1
      map := fun f => ModuleCat.ofHom f.val
      map_id := fun _ => rfl
      map_comp := fun _ _ => rfl }
let Good := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) (F : CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod R) (Mod S)) =>
  CategoryTheory.Functor.Additive F ∧
  CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits F ∧
  ∀ I : Type (max u v), CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape
    (CategoryTheory.Discrete I) F
let PreservingFunctors := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) => CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (Good S R)
let incl := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) => CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ι (Good S R)
let regular := fun (R : RingCat.{u}) => ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{v} R)
let rho : ∀ (R : RingCat.{u}), R → ModuleCat.Hom (regular R) (regular R) :=
  fun R r =>
    ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearEquiv.conjRingEquiv
      (LinearEquiv.symm (ULift.moduleEquiv : ULift.{v} R ≃ₗ[R] R)) (LinearMap.mulRight R r))
let eval := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) =>
  CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (incl S R)
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.evaluation (Mod R) (Mod S)) (regular R))
let Balanced := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) (B : Bimod S R) (X : Mod R) (Y : Mod S)
    (p : B.1 → X → Y) =>
  (∀ (b b' : B.1) (x : X), p (b + b') x = p b x + p b' x) ∧
  (∀ (b : B.1) (x x' : X), p b (x + x') = p b x + p b x') ∧
  (∀ (s : S) (b : B.1) (x : X), p (s • b) x = s • p b x) ∧
  (∀ (r : R) (b : B.1) (x : X), p (right S R B b r) x = p b (r • x))
∃ EW : ∀ S R : RingCat.{u}, CategoryTheory.Equivalence (Bimod S R) (PreservingFunctors S R),
  let tensor := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) (B : Bimod S R) =>
    CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (incl S R) ((EW S R).functor.obj B)
  ∃ pure : ∀ (S R : RingCat.{u}) (B : Bimod S R) (X : Mod R), B.1 → X → (tensor S R B).obj X,
    (∀ (S R : RingCat.{u}) (B : Bimod S R) (X : Mod R),
      Balanced S R B X ((tensor S R B).obj X) (pure S R B X) ∧
      ∀ (Y : Mod S) (p : B.1 → X → Y), Balanced S R B X Y p →

          ∀ (b : B.1) (x : X), f (pure S R B X b x) = p b x) ∧
    (∀ (S R : RingCat.{u}) (B : Bimod S R) (X Y : Mod R)
      (f : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) (b : B.1) (x : X),
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((tensor S R B).map f) (pure S R B X b x) =
        pure S R B Y b (ModuleCat.Hom.hom f x)) ∧
    (∀ (S R : RingCat.{u}) (B B' : Bimod S R) (f : Hom S R B B')
      (X : Mod R) (b : B.1) (x : X),
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom
        (CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app ((incl S R).map ((EW S R).functor.map f)) X)
        (pure S R B X b x) = pure S R B' X (f.val b) x) ∧
    (∀ S R : RingCat.{u},
      ∃ h : CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (EW S R).inverse (forgetBimod S R) = eval S R,

            toEval (right S R ((EW S R).inverse.obj F) m r) =
              ModuleCat.Hom.hom (F.obj.map (rho R r)) (toEval m)) ∧
    (∀ (T S R : RingCat.{u}) (C : Bimod T S) (B : Bimod S R),
      ∃ a : Actions T R ((tensor T S C).obj B.1),
        let CB : Bimod T R := ⟨(tensor T S C).obj B.1, a⟩
        (∀ (c : C.1) (b : B.1) (r : R),
          right T R CB (pure T S C B.1 c b) r = pure T S C B.1 c (right S R B b r)) ∧
        ∃ i : CategoryTheory.Iso (tensor T R CB)
            (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (tensor S R B) (tensor T S C)),
          ∀ (X : Mod R) (c : C.1) (b : B.1) (x : X),
            ModuleCat.Hom.hom (i.hom.app X) (pure T R CB X (pure T S C B.1 c b) x) =
              pure T S C ((tensor S R B).obj X) c (pure S R B X b x)) ∧
    (∀ R : RingCat.{u}, ∃ a : Actions R R (regular R),
      let RR : Bimod R R := ⟨regular R, a⟩
      (∀ (x : ULift.{v} R) (r : R), right R R RR x r = ULift.up (x.down * r)) ∧
      ∃ i : CategoryTheory.Iso (tensor R R RR) (CategoryTheory.Functor.id (Mod R)),
        ∀ (X : Mod R) (r : ULift.{v} R) (x : X),
          ModuleCat.Hom.hom (i.hom.app X) (pure R R RR X r x) = r.down • x)

ComplexEilenbergWatts.type:
∀ (S R : RingCat.{u}) [Algebra Complex S] [Algebra Complex R],
  let ew := Classical.choose _root_.EilenbergWatts S R
  let Bimod := Sigma (fun M : ModuleCat.{max u v} S =>
    { a : _root_.Bimodule.1 S R M // a.1 = ModuleCat.isModule M })
  let Good := fun F : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (ModuleCat.{max u v} S) =>
    CategoryTheory.Functor.Additive F ∧
    CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits F ∧
    ∀ I : Type (max u v),
      CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.Discrete I) F
  let GoodFunctors := CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory Good
  letI : CategoryTheory.Category.{max u v} Bimod :=
    (fun (c : CategoryTheory.Category.{max u v} Bimod)
      (_ : @CategoryTheory.Equivalence Bimod GoodFunctors c inferInstance) => c) _ ew
  let EqualScalars : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty Bimod := fun B =>
    letI : Module (MulOpposite R) B.1 := B.2.1.2.1
    ∀ (z : Complex) (b : B.1),
      algebraMap Complex S z • b = MulOpposite.op (algebraMap Complex R z) • b
  let ComplexLinear : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty GoodFunctors := fun F =>
    CategoryTheory.Functor.Linear Complex F.obj
  (∀ B : Bimod, EqualScalars B ↔ ComplexLinear (ew.functor.obj B)) ∧
  ∃ restricted : CategoryTheory.Equivalence
      (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory EqualScalars)
      (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory ComplexLinear),
    CategoryTheory.Functor.comp restricted.functor (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ι ComplexLinear) =
      CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ι EqualScalars) ew.functor

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),

  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H

    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β

        Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H

        (_ : ∀ (j : J) (h : H), ∃! i : I j, (h : U) * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ ∈ C j)
        (j : J),
        let s := σ j
        let l := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at h
            change k ∈ K at hk
            rw [← h]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
        let r := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, e⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (s : U) * β * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at e
            change h ∈ H at hh
            rw [← e]
            convert hh using 1
            group)

          ⟨s, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (s : U) =
              (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *

        let gk := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
        let kl := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up l
        let lh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down r
        let hl := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up r
        let gh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
        let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kg gh
        let Mj := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kl lh

          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate kg gk Mj) (
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate gk kl lh)) (
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal

          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical

          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg)

            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg)

          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate kg gk Mj) (

            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap a)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id Mj))
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit Mj)))))
        let cupTerm := fun (g : G) (h : H) =>

            (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair gh.basis (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor hl lh).basis 1

          Σ trace : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex cupBoundary mid,
          Σ _after : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex mid q,
          {rep : I j → H // ∀ z, Set.Finite (Function.support (cupContribution trace rep z))}

          Sum (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex p q) (ScopedCupDiagram p q)

          let before := shape.1
          let trace := shape.2.2.1

        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g' a) :=

∀ (C : Type u) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] (P : C),
  let isKernel := fun {X Y K : C} (f : Quiver.Hom X Y) (ι : Quiver.Hom K X) =>
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ι f = 0 ∧
      ∀ (T : C) (g : Quiver.Hom T X),
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g f = 0 →
        ExistsUnique (fun h : Quiver.Hom T K => CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h ι = g)
  let isCokernel := fun {X Y Q : C} (f : Quiver.Hom X Y) (π : Quiver.Hom Y Q) =>
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f π = 0 ∧
      ∀ (T : C) (g : Quiver.Hom Y T),
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g = 0 →
        ExistsUnique (fun h : Quiver.Hom Q T => CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp π h = g)
  let isCoproduct := fun {I : Type v} (X : I → C) (Q : C)
      (ι : ∀ i, Quiver.Hom (X i) Q) =>
    ∀ (T : C) (g : ∀ i, Quiver.Hom (X i) T),
      ExistsUnique (fun h : Quiver.Hom Q T =>
        ∀ i, CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (ι i) h = g i)
  let A := MulOpposite (CategoryTheory.End P)
  let M := ModuleCat.{v} A
  let H : CategoryTheory.Functor C M := CategoryTheory.preadditiveCoyonedaObj P
  let homGroup := fun X : C => AddCommGrpCat.of (Quiver.Hom P X)
  let homGroupMap := fun {X Y : C} (f : Quiver.Hom X Y) =>
    (AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
      (LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (H.map f))) :
      Quiver.Hom (homGroup X) (homGroup Y))
  (∀ (J : Type v) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v} J] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor J C),
    ∃ (Q : C) (ι : ∀ j, Quiver.Hom (F.obj j) Q),
      (∀ (i j : J) (f : Quiver.Hom i j),
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (F.map f) (ι j) = ι i) ∧
      ∀ (T : C) (g : ∀ j, Quiver.Hom (F.obj j) T),
        (∀ (i j : J) (f : Quiver.Hom i j),
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (F.map f) (g j) = g i) →
        ExistsUnique (fun h : Quiver.Hom Q T =>
          ∀ j, CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (ι j) h = g j)) →
  (∀ (n : Nat) (X : Fin n → C),
    ∃ (Q : C) (π : ∀ i, Quiver.Hom Q (X i)),
      ∀ (T : C) (g : ∀ i, Quiver.Hom T (X i)),
        ExistsUnique (fun h : Quiver.Hom T Q =>
          ∀ i, CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp h (π i) = g i)) →
  (∀ (X Y : C) (f : Quiver.Hom X Y), ∃ (K : C) (ι : Quiver.Hom K X), isKernel f ι) →
  (∀ (X Y : C) (f : Quiver.Hom X Y), ∃ (Q : C) (π : Quiver.Hom Y Q), isCokernel f π) →
  (∀ (X Y : C) (f : Quiver.Hom X Y), CategoryTheory.Mono f →
    ∃ (Z : C) (g : Quiver.Hom Y Z), isKernel g f) →
  (∀ (X Y : C) (f : Quiver.Hom X Y), CategoryTheory.Epi f →
    ∃ (Z : C) (g : Quiver.Hom Z X), isCokernel g f) →
  CategoryTheory.Projective P →
  CategoryTheory.IsSeparator P →
  (∀ (I : Type v) (X : I → C) (Q : C) (ι : ∀ i, Quiver.Hom (X i) Q),
    isCoproduct X Q ι →
    ∀ (T : AddCommGrpCat.{v}) (g : ∀ i, Quiver.Hom (homGroup (X i)) T),
      ExistsUnique (fun h : Quiver.Hom (homGroup Q) T =>
        ∀ i, CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (homGroupMap (ι i)) h = g i)) →
  ∀ (copower : ∀ I : Type v,
      Σ Q : C, Σ ι : I → Quiver.Hom P Q,
        ∀ T : C,
          { e : Equiv (Quiver.Hom Q T) (I → Quiver.Hom P T) //
            ∀ (h : Quiver.Hom Q T) (i : I),
              e h i = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (ι i) h })
    (cokernel : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : Quiver.Hom X Y),
      Σ Q : C, Σ π : { p : Quiver.Hom Y Q //
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f p = 0 },
        ∀ T : C,
          { e : Equiv (Quiver.Hom Q T)
              { g : Quiver.Hom Y T // CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g = 0 } //
            ∀ h : Quiver.Hom Q T,
              (e h).val = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp π.val h }),
  let coefficients := fun I : Type v =>
    Σ s : Finset I, { a : I → A // ∀ i, Multiset.Mem s.val i ↔ a i ≠ 0 }
  let relations := fun V : M =>
    { r : coefficients (↥V) //
      Finset.sum r.1 (fun x => r.2.val x • x) = (0 : ↥V) }
  let transpose := fun V : M =>
    let generators := copower (↥V)
    let relationCopower := copower (relations V)
    ((relationCopower.2.2 generators.1).val.symm) (fun r : relations V =>
      Finset.sum r.val.1 (fun x =>
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
          (CategoryTheory.End.asHom (MulOpposite.unop (r.val.2.val x)))
          (generators.2.1 x)))
  let presentationCokernel := fun V : M => cokernel (transpose V)
  ∀ (L : CategoryTheory.Functor M C),
  let HL : CategoryTheory.Functor M M :=
    { obj := fun V => H.obj (L.obj V)
      map := fun f => H.map (L.map f)
      map_id := fun V => (congrArg H.map (L.map_id V)).trans (H.map_id (L.obj V))
      map_comp := fun f g => (congrArg H.map (L.map_comp f g)).trans (H.map_comp _ _) }
  let LH : CategoryTheory.Functor C C :=
    { obj := fun X => L.obj (H.obj X)
      map := fun f => L.map (H.map f)
      map_id := fun X => (congrArg L.map (H.map_id X)).trans (L.map_id (H.obj X))
      map_comp := fun f g => (congrArg L.map (H.map_comp f g)).trans (L.map_comp _ _) }
  ∀ (adj :
      Σ η : CategoryTheory.NatTrans (CategoryTheory.Functor.id M) HL,
        { ε : CategoryTheory.NatTrans LH (CategoryTheory.Functor.id C) //
          (∀ V : M,
            CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (L.map (η.app V)) (ε.app (L.obj V)) =
              CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (L.obj V)) ∧
          (∀ X : C,
            CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (η.app (H.obj X)) (H.map (ε.app X)) =
              CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (H.obj X)) })
    (presentationIso : ∀ V : M, CategoryTheory.Iso (presentationCokernel V).1 (L.obj V)),
    let η := adj.1
    let ε := adj.2.val
    (∀ (V : M) (x : ↥V),
      (η.app V) x =
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((copower (↥V)).2.1 x)
          (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
            (presentationCokernel V).2.1.val (presentationIso V).hom)) →
    ∃ (ηInv : CategoryTheory.NatTrans HL (CategoryTheory.Functor.id M))
      (εInv : CategoryTheory.NatTrans (CategoryTheory.Functor.id C) LH),
      (∀ V : M,
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (η.app V) (ηInv.app V) =
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id V ∧
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (ηInv.app V) (η.app V) =
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (HL.obj V)) ∧
      (∀ X : C,
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (ε.app X) (εInv.app X) =
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (LH.obj X) ∧
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (εInv.app X) (ε.app X) =
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X)

MackeyIdentityDiagram.type:
∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J =>
        Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
      let l := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at h
            change k ∈ K at hk
            rw [← h]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
      let r := fun j : J =>
        let s := σ j
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, e⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (s : U) * β * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at e
            change h ∈ H at hh
            rw [← e]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let d := fun j : J =>
        let s := σ j
        show MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (l j))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b (r j)) from
          ⟨s, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (s : U) =
              (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
      let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up
      let Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (l j)) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (r j))
      ∃ hf : ∀ (j : J) (z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier),
          Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b (l j) (r j) (d j) w = z},
        let inclusion : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (Mj j) M := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication a b (l j) (r j) (d j)
        let projection : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M (Mj j) := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection a b (l j) (r j) (d j) (hf j)
        let straight : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up)
        let crossed : J → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M M := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (projection j) (inclusion j)
        let term := fun (x : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier →₀ Complex) (j : J) =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (crossed j)) x
        (∃ finite : ∀ x, Set.Finite (Function.support (term x)),
          ∀ x, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight) x =
            Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (finite x)) (term x)) ∧
        (∀ j : J,
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (inclusion j) (projection j)) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (Mj j))) ∧
        (∀ (i j : J), i ≠ j →
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (inclusion i) (projection j)) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero (Mj i) (Mj j)))

MackeySummandProjection.type:
∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J =>
        Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
      let C := fun j : J =>
        Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))) (L j)
      ∀ (I : J → Type v) (hRep : ∀ j : J, I j → H)
        (_ : ∀ (j : J) (h : H), ∃! i : I j, (h : U) * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ ∈ C j)
        (j : J),
        let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
          (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
        let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
          (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
        let s := σ j
        let l := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change k ∈ K at hk
            rw [← heq]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
        let r := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change ((s : U) * β) * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change h ∈ H at hh
            rw [← heq]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
        let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a l) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b r) :=
          ⟨s, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (s : U) =
              (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
        let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b)
        let Mj := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up l) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down r)
        let surviving := fun (g : G) =>
          {i : I j | α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹ * α ∈ K}
        ∃ (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite
            {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d w = z})
          (hs : ∀ g : G, Set.Finite (surviving g)),
          let p : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M Mj :=
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection a b l r d hf
          let ι : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex Mj M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication a b l r d
          let composite := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical p ι
          ∀ g : G,
            let z := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b g
            let image := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval composite) (Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex))
            image = Finsupp.single z (Finset.card (Set.Finite.toFinset (hs g)) : Complex) ∧
              (DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j → image = Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex)) ∧
              (DoubleCoset.mk A B g ≠ j → image = 0)

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (γ α β : U)
    (hγ : ∀ h : H, γ * (h : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (he : α * β⁻¹ ∈ H),
  let g := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives α β (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) he
  let rightDot := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) e
  let split := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) g a
  (∀ (γ' : U)
      (hγ' : ∀ h : H, γ' * (h : U) * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hd : γ * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let g' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ' hγ'
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot g g' :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives γ γ' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hd
    let lifted : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g' a) :=
      ⟨MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d,
        fun k => MackeyDiagrams.Dot.intertwines d
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a k)⟩
    let merged := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical lifted (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g' e)
    let left := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical split
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot d) rightDot)
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot merged)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp g' b)
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval left = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right) ∧
  (let left := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical split
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up g)) rightDot)
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g e))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp g b)
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval left = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right)

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (γ α β : U)
    (hγ : ∀ h : H, γ * (h : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (he : α * β⁻¹ ∈ H),
  let g := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives α β (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) he
  let innerDot := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.downDot (R := Complex) e
  let merge := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown (R := Complex) g a
  (∀ (γ' : U)
      (hγ' : ∀ h : H, γ' * (h : U) * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hd : γ * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let g' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ' hγ'
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot g g' :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives γ γ' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hd
    let lifted : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g' a) :=
      ⟨MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d,
        fun k => MackeyDiagrams.Dot.intertwines d
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a k)⟩
    let merged := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical lifted (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g' e)
    let left := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal innerDot (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.downDot d))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown g' b)
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical merge (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.downDot merged)
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval left = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right) ∧
  (let left := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal innerDot
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down g)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown g b)
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical merge
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.downDot (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g e))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval left = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right)

            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical cup

                (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
  (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
  (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let A := MonoidAlgebra Complex H
  let B := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let φ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let ψ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b)
  let orbit := fun g : G =>
    Set.range (fun h : H =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a h * g * (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b h)⁻¹)
  let OrbitIndex := {s : Finset G // ∃ g : G, (s : Set G) = orbit g}
  let orbitSum := fun i : OrbitIndex =>
    Finset.sum (Subtype.val i) (fun g => MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex))
  let HomSpace : Submodule Complex (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) B B) :=
    { carrier := { f |
        (∀ s x : B, f (s * x) = s * f x) ∧
        (∀ (r : A) (x : B), f (x * φ r) = f x * ψ r) }
      zero_mem' := by
        simp
      add_mem' := by
        rintro f g ⟨hfL, hfR⟩ ⟨hgL, hgR⟩
        exact ⟨fun s x => by simp [hfL, hgL, mul_add],
          fun r x => by simp [hfR, hgR, add_mul]⟩
      smul_mem' := by
        rintro c f ⟨hfL, hfR⟩
        exact ⟨fun s x => by simp [hfL],
          fun r x => by simp [hfR]⟩ }
  ∃ basis : Module.Basis OrbitIndex Complex HomSpace,
    (∀ (i : OrbitIndex) (x : B), Subtype.val (basis i) x = x * orbitSum i) ∧
    (∀ g : G, (∃ d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d = g) ↔ orbit g = {g}) ∧
    (Finite H → ∀ i : OrbitIndex,
      ∃ d : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b),
        ∀ x : B,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval d) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) =
            MonoidAlgebra.coeff (Subtype.val (basis i) x))

∀ {ι : Type*} {κ : Type*} [Finite ι] [Finite κ] (X : Finset Nat)
    (A : ι → Finset Nat) (B : κ → Finset Nat),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (A i)) →
  (∀ j, Finset.Nonempty (B j)) →
  Pairwise (fun i i' => Disjoint (A i) (A i')) →
  Pairwise (fun j j' => Disjoint (B j) (B j')) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ A i) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ j, n ∈ B j) →
  let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
    fun S => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
  let block : Sum ι κ → Finset Nat := Sum.elim A B
  let graph : SimpleGraph (Sum ι κ) := SimpleGraph.fromRel fun u v =>
    match u, v with
    | Sum.inl i, Sum.inr j => Finset.Nonempty (A i ∩ B j)
    | _, _ => False
  let componentBlock : SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent graph → Finset Nat := fun c =>
    let inComponent : Nat → Prop := fun n =>
      ∃ v : Sum ι κ, SimpleGraph.connectedComponentMk graph v = c ∧ n ∈ block v
    @Finset.filter Nat inComponent (Classical.decPred inComponent) X
  ((iSup fun i => blockSym (A i)) ⊔ (iSup fun j => blockSym (B j))) =
    iSup fun c => blockSym (componentBlock c)

        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹

            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := ℓ.property.1

            change k ∈ K at hk
            rw [← h]
            convert hk using 1
            group)

        let s := σ j
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)

            intro ℓ

      let Vj := fun j : J => Finsupp (Wj j).carrier Complex

          (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm

            (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := S))
            (Rep.indFunctor Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f)))
          (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := T)) :
          CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod S) (Mod T))

  fun S => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun m : Nat => m ∈ S))
let parabolicOn : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) → Prop :=
  fun X H =>
    ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
      (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
      (∀ m : Nat, m ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, m ∈ blocks i) ∧
      H = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))

  fun H => ∃ X, parabolicOn X H
(∀ (H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)), parabolic H →
  ∀ α : ↥(Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}),
    parabolic (Subgroup.map
      (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (α : Equiv.Perm Nat))) H)) ∧
(∀ (X : Finset Nat) (H K : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)),
  parabolicOn X H → parabolicOn X K →
    parabolicOn X (H ⊓ K) ∧ parabolicOn X (H ⊔ K))
