FiniteOrbitSumDiagram.type:
∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
  (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
  (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let A := MonoidAlgebra Complex H
  let B := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let φ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let ψ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b)
  let action := fun (h : H) (g : G) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a h * g * (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b h)⁻¹
  let orbit := fun g : G => Set.range (fun h : H => action h g)
  let OrbitIndex := {s : Finset G // ∃ g : G, (s : Set G) = orbit g}
  let orbitSum := fun i : OrbitIndex =>
    Finset.sum (Subtype.val i) (fun g => MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex))
  let HomSpace : Submodule Complex (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) B B) :=
    { carrier := { f |
        (∀ s x : B, f (s * x) = s * f x) ∧
        (∀ (r : A) (x : B), f (x * φ r) = f x * ψ r) }
      zero_mem' := by
        simp
      add_mem' := by
        rintro f g ⟨hfL, hfR⟩ ⟨hgL, hgR⟩
        exact ⟨fun s x => by simp [hfL, hgL, mul_add],
          fun r x => by simp [hfR, hgR, add_mul]⟩
      smul_mem' := by
        rintro c f ⟨hfL, hfR⟩
        exact ⟨fun s x => by simp [hfL],
          fun r x => by simp [hfR]⟩ }
  ∃ basis : Module.Basis OrbitIndex Complex HomSpace,
    (∀ (i : OrbitIndex) (x : B), Subtype.val (basis i) x = x * orbitSum i) ∧
    (∀ g : G, (∃ d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d = g) ↔ orbit g = {g}) ∧
    (∀ [Finite H],
      let T : Subgroup U := ⊥
      let j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T H :=
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (1 : U) (by
          intro t
          have ht : (t : U) = 1 := Subgroup.mem_bot.mp t.property
          simp [ht])
      let finiteIndex : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom j)) :=
        Subgroup.finiteIndex_of_finite
      let p := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
      let q := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up j
      let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down j
      let groupElements : Finset H := @Finset.univ H (Fintype.ofFinite H)
      ∀ g : G,
        let finiteOrbit : Set.Finite (orbit g) := Set.finite_range (fun h : H => action h g)
        let i : OrbitIndex :=
          ⟨Set.Finite.toFinset finiteOrbit, ⟨g, Set.Finite.coe_toFinset finiteOrbit⟩⟩
        let order : Complex := (Nat.card {h : H // action h g = g} : Complex)
        let dot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a j)
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b j) :=
          { element := g
            intertwines := by
              intro t
              have ht : t = 1 := Subtype.ext (Subgroup.mem_bot.mp t.property)
              rw [ht, map_one, map_one, one_mul, mul_one] }
        let cup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup (R := Complex) j finiteIndex)
        let merge := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a j) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down)
        let dotStep := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) dot) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down)
        let split := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) b j) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down)
        let cap := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id q) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap (R := Complex) j)
        let d : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex p q :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit p)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical cup
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p up down)
                (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical merge
                  (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical dotStep
                    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical split
                      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate q up down)
                        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical cap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit q))))))))
        let sumOverH : B := Finset.sum groupElements (fun t =>
          MonoidAlgebra.single
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a t⁻¹ * g * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b t)
            (1 : Complex))
        IsUnit order ∧
        (∀ x : B,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval d)
              (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (x * sumOverH) ∧
          x * sumOverH = x * (order • orbitSum i)) ∧
        (∀ x : B,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale order⁻¹ d))
              (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (Subtype.val (basis i) x)))

let A : Finset Nat := Finset.Icc 1 6
let B : Finset Nat := Finset.Icc 7 12
let supportK : Finset Nat := Finset.Icc 1 3
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  fun S => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
let subgroupProduct : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) →
    Set (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  fun S T => Set.image2 (fun x y => x * y) (S : Set (Equiv.Perm Nat))
    (T : Set (Equiv.Perm Nat))
let G := blockSym A ⊔ blockSym B
let H := G
let K := blockSym supportK
let Hhat := blockSym (A ∪ B)
let Khat := blockSym supportK
let β : Equiv.Perm Nat := 1
∃ (α : Equiv.Perm Nat)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : Equiv.Perm Nat) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : Equiv.Perm Nat) * β⁻¹ ∈ H),
  Finset.image α A = B ∧
  Finset.image α B = A ∧
  α ∈ subgroupProduct G Hhat ∧
  β ∈ subgroupProduct H Khat ∧
  (∀ γ ∈ subgroupProduct G Khat, Finset.image γ A = A ∧ Finset.image γ B = B) ∧
  Set.MapsTo (⇑(α * β)) (supportK : Set Nat) (B : Set Nat) ∧
  α * β ∉ subgroupProduct G Khat ∧
  ¬ ∃ (γ : Equiv.Perm Nat) (_ : γ ∈ subgroupProduct G Khat)
      (hγ : ∀ k : K, γ * (k : Equiv.Perm Nat) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G),
    MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ =
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ)

OrdinaryMackeyDecomposition.type:
∀ {G : Type u} [Group G] (K H : Subgroup G),
  let I := DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : I → G) (_ : ∀ i : I, DoubleCoset.mk K H (σ i) = i),
    let L := fun i : I => K ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (σ i))) H
    let incLK := fun i : I =>
      Subgroup.inclusion (show L i ≤ K from inf_le_left)
    let μ := fun i : I =>
      MonoidHom.codRestrict
        (MonoidHom.comp (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (σ i)⁻¹)) (Subgroup.subtype (L i)))
        H (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨h, hh, he⟩ := ℓ.property.2
          change σ i * h * (σ i)⁻¹ = (ℓ : G) at he
          change h ∈ H at hh
          change (σ i)⁻¹ * (ℓ : G) * ((σ i)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H
          rw [← he]
          convert hh using 1
          group)
    let Mod := fun A : Type u => fun [Group A] => ModuleCat.{max u v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex A)
    let Res := fun {A B : Type u} [Group A] [Group B] (f : A →* B) =>
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f).toRingHom :
        CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod B) (Mod A))
    let Ind := fun {A B : Type u} [Group A] [Group B] (f : A →* B) =>
      (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
          (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := A))
          (Rep.indFunctor Complex f))
        (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := B)) :
          CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod A) (Mod B))
    let F := CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Ind (Subgroup.subtype H)) (Res (Subgroup.subtype K))
    let S := fun i : I => CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Res (μ i)) (Ind (incLK i))
    let regular := fun (A : Type u) [Group A] =>
      ModuleCat.of (MonoidAlgebra Complex A) (ULift.{v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex A))
    let regularH := regular H
    let regularG := regular G
    let rightMulH := fun a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H =>
      (ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{v, u} (MonoidAlgebra Complex H)).map
        (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.mulRight (MonoidAlgebra Complex H) a))
    let tmul := fun {A B : Type u} [Group A] [Group B] (f : A →* B)
        (M : Mod A) (b : B) (m : ↥M) =>
      let N := (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := A)).obj M
      let x : ↥N := (RestrictScalars.addEquiv Complex (MonoidAlgebra Complex A) (↥M)).symm m
      let y : ↥(Rep.ind f N) := (Representation.IndV.mk f N.ρ b⁻¹) x
      (show ↥((Ind f).obj M) from
        (Representation.asModuleEquiv (Rep.ind f N).ρ).symm y)
    let targetBasis : G → ↥(F.obj regularH) := fun g =>
      tmul (Subgroup.subtype H) regularH g (ULift.up (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex H))
    let summandTmul : ∀ i : I, K → H → ↥((S i).obj regularH) := fun i k h =>
      tmul (incLK i) ((Res (μ i)).obj regularH) k (ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex H h))
    ∃ (e : CategoryTheory.Iso F (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj S))
      (c : CategoryTheory.Iso (F.obj regularH) ((Res (Subgroup.subtype K)).obj regularG)),
      (∀ g : G, c.hom (targetBasis g) = ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G g)) ∧
      (∀ (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H) (x : ↥(F.obj regularH)),
        c.hom ((F.map (rightMulH a)) x) =
          ULift.up (ULift.down (c.hom x) *
            MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (Subgroup.subtype H) a)) ∧
      (∀ (i : I) (k : K) (h : H),
        c.hom (e.inv.app regularH
          ((CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι S i).app regularH (summandTmul i k h))) =
            ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G ((k : G) * σ i * (h : G))))

∀ {ι κ : Type*} (X : ι → Set Nat) (Y : κ → Set Nat),
  (∀ i, Set.Nonempty (X i)) → (∀ j, Set.Nonempty (Y j)) →
  Pairwise (fun i i' => Disjoint (X i) (X i')) →
  Pairwise (fun j j' => Disjoint (Y j) (Y j')) →
  let U := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
  let blockSym := fun B : Set Nat => _root_.fixingSubgroup (↥U) Bᶜ
  let H := iSup (fun i => blockSym (X i))

let B₁ : Set Nat := {1, 2, 3}
  let B₂ : Set Nat := {4, 5, 6}
  let B₃ : Set Nat := {7, 8, 9}
  let B₄ : Set Nat := {10, 11, 12}
  let X : Fin 4 → Set Nat := ![B₁, B₂, B₃, B₄]
  let Y : Fin 2 → Set Nat := ![B₁ ∪ B₂, B₃ ∪ B₄]
  let U := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
  let blockSym := fun B : Set Nat => _root_.fixingSubgroup (↥U) Bᶜ
  let H := iSup (fun i => blockSym (X i))
  let G := iSup (fun j => blockSym (Y j))
  let swap := fun (i j : Nat) (hij : i ≠ j) =>
    (⟨Equiv.swap i j, Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩⟩ : ↥U)
  let α := swap 4 7 (by decide) * swap 5 8 (by decide) * swap 6 9 (by decide)
  let β : ↥U := 1
  ∃ (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : ↥U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : ↥U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
    let orbit := Set.range (fun h : H =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a h * (1 : G) *
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b h)⁻¹)
    (∀ (g : G) (j : Fin 2), Set.MapsTo (⇑((g : ↥U) : Equiv.Perm Nat)) (Y j) (Y j)) ∧
    (∃ t : H,
      ((t : ↥U) : Equiv.Perm Nat) = Equiv.swap 4 5 ∧
      (((MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a t : G) : ↥U) : Equiv.Perm Nat) =
        Equiv.swap 7 8 ∧
      (((MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b t : G) : ↥U) : Equiv.Perm Nat) =
        Equiv.swap 4 5) ∧
    ¬ Nonempty (MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) ∧
    ∃ s : Finset G, (s : Set G) = orbit ∧
      let B := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
      let orbitSum : B := Finset.sum s (fun g => MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex))
      ∃ d : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b),
        let f := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval d)
        f ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ x : B, f (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (x * orbitSum)

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U)
    (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H) (γ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G),
  let composite := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp γ α
  let alphaHom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α
  let gammaHom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom γ
  let alphaIndex := Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range alphaHom)
  let compositeIndex :=
    Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom composite))
  let upAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up α
  let downAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down α
  let upGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up γ
  let downGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down γ
  let upComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up composite
  let downComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down composite
  let idUpAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upAlpha
  let idDownAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downAlpha
  let idUpGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upGamma
  let idDownGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downGamma
  let idUpComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upComposite
  let idDownComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downComposite
  let multiplicationCapBend : Prop :=
    let input := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upComposite downAlpha
    let left : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex input upGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp γ α) idDownAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate upGamma upAlpha downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpGamma
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap α))
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit upGamma)))
    let rightBranch : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex downAlpha
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downComposite upGamma) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit downAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownAlpha (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup γ))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate downAlpha downGamma upGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown γ α) idUpGamma)))
    let right : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex input upGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpComposite rightBranch)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upComposite downComposite upGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap composite) idUpGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit upGamma)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval left = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right
  let ordinaryCupBend : Prop :=
    let output := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downGamma upComposite
    let left : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upAlpha output :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit upAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup γ) idUpAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate downGamma upGamma upAlpha)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownGamma (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp γ α))))
    let rightBranch : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upAlpha downComposite) downGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpAlpha (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown γ α))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upAlpha downAlpha downGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap α) idDownGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit downGamma)))
    let right : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upAlpha output :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit upAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpAlpha
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup composite))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upAlpha downComposite upComposite)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal rightBranch idUpComposite)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval left = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right
  let traceInput := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downComposite upGamma
  let reverseOutput := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upComposite downAlpha
  let traceLeft : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex traceInput downAlpha :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown γ α) idUpGamma)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate downAlpha downGamma upGamma)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownAlpha (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap γ))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit downAlpha)))
  let reverseLeft (finiteAlpha : alphaIndex) :
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upGamma reverseOutput :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit upGamma)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpGamma
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup α finiteAlpha))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upGamma upAlpha downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp γ α) idDownAlpha)))
  let traceCapBend : Prop := ∀ finiteAlpha : alphaIndex,
    let right : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex traceInput downAlpha :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownComposite (reverseLeft finiteAlpha))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate downComposite upComposite downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap composite)
              idDownAlpha)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit downAlpha)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval traceLeft = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right
  let reverseCupBend : Prop := ∀ finiteComposite : compositeIndex,
    let finiteAlpha : alphaIndex := by
      let _ : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MonoidHom.comp gammaHom alphaHom)) :=
        finiteComposite
      have finitePreimage : Subgroup.FiniteIndex
          (Subgroup.comap gammaHom (MonoidHom.range (MonoidHom.comp gammaHom alphaHom))) :=
        inferInstance
      rw [MonoidHom.range_comp, Subgroup.comap_map_eq_self_of_injective
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.injective γ)] at finitePreimage
      exact finitePreimage
    let right : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upGamma reverseOutput :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit upGamma)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup composite finiteComposite) idUpGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate upComposite downComposite upGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpComposite traceLeft)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (reverseLeft finiteAlpha) = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right
  multiplicationCapBend ∧ ordinaryCupBend ∧ traceCapBend ∧ reverseCupBend

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G L : Subgroup U) (α β a b : U),
  let conjSubgroup := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
  let Kα := conjSubgroup α K
  let Hβ := conjSubgroup β H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G)
    (ha : conjSubgroup a L ≤ K) (hb : conjSubgroup b L ≤ H)
    (hs : (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun x => hK ⟨(x : U), x.property, rfl⟩)
    let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun y => hH ⟨(y : U), y.property, rfl⟩)
    let ea := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L) (G := K) a
      (fun ℓ => ha ⟨(ℓ : U), ℓ.property, rfl⟩)
    let eb := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L) (G := H) b
      (fun ℓ => hb ⟨(ℓ : U), ℓ.property, rfl⟩)
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα ea)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ eb) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * a) (β * b)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change α * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
          group)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change β * (b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
          group) hs
    let s := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ i : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ i) = i)
      (j : J) (_ : DoubleCoset.mk A B s = j) (k : K) (h : H)
      (_ : s = MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα k * σ j *
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ h),
      let Lj := Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let Ls := Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H
      let Limage := conjSubgroup (α * a) L
      let Lprime := conjSubgroup (α * (k : U)⁻¹ * a) L
      let leftJ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj) (G := K) α⁻¹
        (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := ℓ.property.1
          change α * x * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at he
          rw [← he]
          change x ∈ K at hx
          convert hx using 1
          group)
      let rightJ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj) (G := H)
        (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := ℓ.property.2
          change ((σ j : U) * β) * y * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at he
          rw [← he]
          change y ∈ H at hy
          convert hy using 1
          group)
      ∃ hSub : Lprime ≤ Lj,
        let leftPrime := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator
          (H := Lprime) (G := K) α⁻¹ (fun ℓ =>
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom leftJ ⟨(ℓ : U), hSub ℓ.property⟩).property)
        let rightPrime := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator
          (H := Lprime) (G := H) (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) (fun ℓ =>
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom rightJ ⟨(ℓ : U), hSub ℓ.property⟩).property)
        let dprime : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα leftPrime)
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ rightPrime) :=
          ⟨σ j, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (σ j : U) =
              (σ j : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
        let X := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction ea
        let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction eb
        let Xprime := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction leftPrime
        let Yprime := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction rightPrime
        let W := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.tensor X Y
        let Wprime := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.tensor Xprime Yprime
        let q := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ ea eb d
        let qprime :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime dprime
        let ι := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) eα eβ ea eb d
        let ιprime := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex)
          eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime dprime
        ∃ (e : W.carrier ≃ Wprime.carrier)
          (he : ∀ (g : K × H) (w : W.carrier),
            e (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act W g w) = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Wprime g (e w)),
          let transport : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex W Wprime :=
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.ofFunction e he
          (∀ (x : K) (y : H),
            e (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair X Y x y) =
              MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair Xprime Yprime (x * k) (h * y)) ∧
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical transport (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval ιprime) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval ι ∧
          (∀ (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | q w = z})
              (hfprime : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | qprime w = z}),
            let p := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) eα eβ ea eb d hf
            let pprime := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex)
              eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime dprime hfprime
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval p) transport =
              MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval pprime) ∧
          Cardinal.mk (Quotient (QuotientGroup.leftRel (Subgroup.subgroupOf Lprime Lj))) =
            Cardinal.mk (Quotient (QuotientGroup.leftRel (Subgroup.subgroupOf Limage Ls)))

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U)
    (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H) (γ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G),
  let composite := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp γ α
  let alphaHom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α
  let gammaHom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom γ
  let alphaIndex := Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range alphaHom)
  let compositeIndex :=
    Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom composite))
  let upAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up α
  let downAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down α
  let upGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up γ
  let downGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down γ
  let upComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up composite
  let downComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down composite
  let idUpAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upAlpha
  let idDownAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downAlpha
  let idUpGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upGamma
  let idDownGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downGamma
  let idUpComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upComposite
  let idDownComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downComposite
  let multiplicationCapVertex : Prop :=
    let input := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upComposite downAlpha
    let straight : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex input upGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp γ α) idDownAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate upGamma upAlpha downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpGamma
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap α))
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit upGamma)))
    let rightBranch : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex downAlpha
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downComposite upGamma) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit downAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownAlpha (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup γ))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate downAlpha downGamma upGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown γ α) idUpGamma)))
    let alternate : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex input upGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpComposite rightBranch)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upComposite downComposite upGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap composite) idUpGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit upGamma)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval alternate
  let traceInput := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downComposite upGamma
  let reverseOutput := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upComposite downAlpha
  let straightTraceCap : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex traceInput downAlpha :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown γ α) idUpGamma)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate downAlpha downGamma upGamma)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownAlpha (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap γ))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit downAlpha)))
  let straightReverseCup (finiteAlpha : alphaIndex) :
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upGamma reverseOutput :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit upGamma)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpGamma
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup α finiteAlpha))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upGamma upAlpha downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp γ α) idDownAlpha)))
  let traceCapVertex : Prop := ∀ finiteAlpha : alphaIndex,
    let alternate : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex traceInput downAlpha :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownComposite (straightReverseCup finiteAlpha))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate downComposite upComposite downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap composite)
              idDownAlpha)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit downAlpha)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straightTraceCap = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval alternate
  let ordinaryCupVertex : Prop :=
    let output := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downGamma upComposite
    let straight : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upAlpha output :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit upAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup γ) idUpAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate downGamma upGamma upAlpha)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownGamma (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp γ α))))
    let rightBranch : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upAlpha downComposite) downGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpAlpha (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown γ α))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upAlpha downAlpha downGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap α) idDownGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit downGamma)))
    let alternate : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upAlpha output :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit upAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpAlpha
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup composite))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upAlpha downComposite upComposite)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal rightBranch idUpComposite)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval alternate
  let reverseCupVertex : Prop := ∀ finiteComposite : compositeIndex,
    let finiteAlpha : alphaIndex := by
      let _ : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MonoidHom.comp gammaHom alphaHom)) :=
        finiteComposite
      have finitePreimage : Subgroup.FiniteIndex
          (Subgroup.comap gammaHom (MonoidHom.range (MonoidHom.comp gammaHom alphaHom))) :=
        inferInstance
      rw [MonoidHom.range_comp, Subgroup.comap_map_eq_self_of_injective
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.injective γ)] at finitePreimage
      exact finitePreimage
    let alternate : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upGamma reverseOutput :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit upGamma)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup composite finiteComposite) idUpGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate upComposite downComposite upGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpComposite straightTraceCap)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (straightReverseCup finiteAlpha) = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval alternate
  multiplicationCapVertex ∧ traceCapVertex ∧ ordinaryCupVertex ∧ reverseCupVertex

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G K H B H' : Subgroup U)
    (α β γ δ α' β' : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hγ : ∀ b : B, γ * (b : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ B)
    (hα' : ∀ h : H', α' * (h : U) * (α')⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ' : ∀ k : K, β' * (k : U) * (β')⁻¹ ∈ H'),
  let u := α * β
  let v := γ * δ
  let w := α' * β'
  let bottom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα)
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ)
  let middle := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ)
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ)
  let top := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α' hα')
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β' hβ')
  let C := Subgroup.centralizer (K : Set U)
  (∀ (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottom middle) (e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot middle top),
    let de := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element e
    (∃ p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottom top, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p = de) ∧
    u⁻¹ * (de : U) * w ∈ C ∧
    (de = 1 → bottom = top)) ∧
  (∀ d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottom middle,
    ∃ r : MackeyDiagrams.Dot middle bottom,
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r = (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d)⁻¹ ∧
      v⁻¹ * (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r : U) * u ∈ C ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical d r = MackeyDiagrams.Dot.id bottom ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical r d = MackeyDiagrams.Dot.id middle)

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G L : Subgroup U) (α β a b : U)
      (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (ha : ∀ ℓ : L, a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹ ∈ K)
      (hb : ∀ ℓ : L, b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹ ∈ H)
      (hs : (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
    let ea := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator a ha
    let eb := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator b hb
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα ea)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ eb) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * a) (β * b)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change α * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
          simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change β * (b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
          simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]) hs
    let s := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d
    let A := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα)
    let B := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ)
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let conjSubgroup := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
        Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
      let Lj := fun j : J => conjSubgroup α K ⊓ conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let leftJ := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            rw [← heq]
            change k ∈ K at hk
            convert hk using 1
            group)
      let rightJ := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            rw [← heq]
            change h ∈ H at hh
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let _Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (leftJ j)) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (rightJ j))
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eα) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up eβ)
      let ML := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ea) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eb)
      let Ls := conjSubgroup α K ⊓ conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H
      let Limage := conjSubgroup (α * a) L
      let n := Subgroup.relIndex Limage Ls
      let qBasis := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ ea eb d
      let q := fun w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ (qBasis w)
      Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex Limage Ls →
        ∃ hf : ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
            Set.Finite {w | qBasis w = z},
          let ι : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex ML M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication eα eβ ea eb d
          let p : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M ML :=
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection eα eβ ea eb d hf
          let pThenIota := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical p ι
          let iotaThenP := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical ι p
          let straight := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) ML
          let orbit := fun j : J => DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
          let P := fun j : J =>
            show ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex]
                ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier →₀ Complex) from by
              classical
              exact Finsupp.lsum Complex (fun z =>
                if MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ z ∈ orbit j
                then Finsupp.lsingle z else 0)
          let finiteQ := fun z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier =>
            show Set.Finite {w | q w = q z} from
              Set.Finite.subset (hf (qBasis z)) (by
                intro w hw
                exact (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedEquiv eα eβ).injective hw)
          ∀ j : J, s ∈ orbit j →
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval pThenIota) =
              (n : Complex) • P j ∧
            (∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier,
              MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval iotaThenP)
                  (Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex)) =
                Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (finiteQ z))
                  (fun w => Finsupp.single w (1 : Complex))) ∧
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval iotaThenP = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight ↔
              n = 1) ∧
            (1 < n → ∀ c : Complex,
              MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale c iotaThenP) ≠
                MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight)

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H B H' G : Subgroup U)
    (α β γ δ α' β' : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hγ : ∀ b : B, γ * (b : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ B)
    (hα' : ∀ h : H', α' * (h : U) * (α')⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ' : ∀ k : K, β' * (k : U) * (β')⁻¹ ∈ H'),
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let c := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let f := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ
  let a' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α' hα'
  let b' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β' hβ'
  let u := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b
  let v := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp c f
  let w := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b'
  let bottomMerge := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown (R := Complex) a b
  let middleSplit := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) c f
  let middleMerge := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown (R := Complex) c f
  let topSplit := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) a' b'
  let lowerCrossing := fun node : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down u) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down v) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical bottomMerge
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical node middleSplit)
  let upperCrossing := fun node : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down v) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down w) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical middleMerge
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical node topSplit)
  let mergedCrossing := fun node : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down u) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down w) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical bottomMerge
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical node topSplit)
  (∀ (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot u v) (e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot v w),
    let dNode := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.downDot (R := Complex) d
    let eNode := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.downDot (R := Complex) e
    let productNode := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.downDot (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical d e)
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (lowerCrossing dNode) (upperCrossing eNode)) =
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (mergedCrossing productNode) ∧
    (∀ x : MonoidAlgebra Complex G,
      let first := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval dNode)
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x)
      let second := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval eNode) first
      let dInv : MonoidAlgebra Complex G := MonoidAlgebra.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d)⁻¹ 1
      let eInv : MonoidAlgebra Complex G := MonoidAlgebra.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element e)⁻¹ 1
      first = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (dInv * x) ∧
      second = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (eInv * (dInv * x)) ∧
      second = MonoidAlgebra.coeff
        (MonoidAlgebra.single ((MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d) * (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element e))⁻¹ 1 * x))) ∧
  (∀ (D : MackeyDiagrams.Dot u v →₀ Complex) (E : MackeyDiagrams.Dot v w →₀ Complex),
    let product : MackeyDiagrams.Dot u w →₀ Complex :=
      Finsupp.sum D (fun d rd =>
        Finsupp.sum E (fun e re => Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical d e) (rd * re)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (lowerCrossing (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.linearDownDot D))
        (upperCrossing (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.linearDownDot E))) =
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (mergedCrossing (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.linearDownDot product)))

  let conjSubgroup := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>

    let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)

        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) a

            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change k ∈ K at hk
            change α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ K
            rw [← heq]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
      let r := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H) (b j)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change h ∈ H at hh
            change (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let A := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα)
  let B := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ)
  let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j) (j : J),
    let s := σ j
    let orbit := DoubleCoset.doubleCoset s (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    let a := α⁻¹
    let b := β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹
    let Lj := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K ⊓
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((s : U) * β))) H
    let left := fun (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := K) a (by
        intro ℓ
        obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).1
        change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
        change α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ K
        rw [← heq]
        change k ∈ K at hk
        convert hk using 1
        group)
    let right := fun (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := H) b (by
        intro ℓ
        obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).2
        change (s : U) * β * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
        change (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) * (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H
        rw [← heq]
        change h ∈ H at hh
        convert hh using 1
        group)
    let dot := fun (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj) =>
      show MackeyDiagrams.Dot
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα (left S hS))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ (right S hS)) from
        ⟨s, by
          intro ℓ
          apply Subtype.ext
          change (α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹) * (s : U) =
            (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *

      let rightL := right L hL
      let leftJ := left Lj (le_refl Lj)
      let rightJ := right Lj (le_refl Lj)
      let dL := dot L hL
      let dJ := dot Lj (le_refl Lj)

        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up leftL) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down rightL)
      let MJ := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up leftJ) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down rightJ)

      let qBasisJ := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ leftJ rightJ dJ

        (hJFinite : ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
          Set.Finite {w | qBasisJ w = z}),
        let hf := fun g : G => show Set.Finite (fiber g) from

            apply (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedEquiv eα eβ).injective
            change q w = MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ

            rw [MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair]
            exact hw)

        let iotaL : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex ML M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication eα eβ leftL rightL dL
        let pL : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M ML :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection eα eβ leftL rightL dL hLFinite
        let iotaJ : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex MJ M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication eα eβ leftJ rightJ dJ
        let pJ : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M MJ :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection eα eβ leftJ rightJ dJ hJFinite
        let outerL := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical pL iotaL
        let outerJ := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical pJ iotaJ
        let innerL := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical iotaL pL
        let straight := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) ML

          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (n : Complex) outerJ) ∧

        (∀ (k : K) (h : H),

            MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα k * s *
              MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ h) ∧
        (∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval iotaL)
              (Finsupp.single z 1) =
            Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ (q z)) 1) ∧
        (∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit →
          Nat.card (fiber g) = n ∧
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval pL)
              (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) 1) = fiberSum g) ∧
        (∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval innerL)
              (Finsupp.single z 1) = fiberSum (q z)) ∧
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval innerL = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight ↔ L = Lj)

              Function.support (term usual basis) = selected) ∧

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G A D F C E : Subgroup U)
    (repGA repAD repDF repGC repCE repEF : U)
    (hGA : ∀ a : A, repGA * (a : U) * repGA⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hAD : ∀ d : D, repAD * (d : U) * repAD⁻¹ ∈ A)
    (hDF : ∀ f : F, repDF * (f : U) * repDF⁻¹ ∈ D)
    (hGC : ∀ c : C, repGC * (c : U) * repGC⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hCE : ∀ e : E, repCE * (e : U) * repCE⁻¹ ∈ C)
    (hEF : ∀ f : F, repEF * (f : U) * repEF⁻¹ ∈ E),
  let ga := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGA hGA
  let ad := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repAD hAD
  let df := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repDF hDF
  let gc := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGC hGC
  let ce := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repCE hCE
  let ef := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repEF hEF
  let u := repGA * repAD * repDF
  let v := repGC * repCE * repEF
  let bottomPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ad
  let topPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc ce
  let bottomEmbedding := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bottomPair df
  let topEmbedding := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp topPair ef
  let word := fun {P Q S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)
  let bottom := word ga ad df
  let top := word gc ce ef
  let splitBottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) bottomPair df)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp ga ad)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up df)))
  let mergeTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) gc ce)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ef)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp topPair ef)
  let mergedEvaluation := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top)
      (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical splitBottom
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical diagram mergeTop)))
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z))
  let multiplier := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top) =>
    mergedEvaluation diagram 1
  let along := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let dotValue := fun {H K : Subgroup U} {a b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K}
      (weights : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) Complex) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (a := a) (b := b)) weights)
  let allowed := fun p : G => u⁻¹ * (p : U) * v ∈ Subgroup.centralizer (F : Set U)
  let realizes := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top)
      (formula : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) =>
    multiplier diagram = formula ∧
      ∀ p ∈ Finsupp.support (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (multiplier diagram)), allowed p
  let crossing := fun {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (weights : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) Complex) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.linearUpDot weights)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp a' b'))
  let crossLeft := fun {P Q Q' S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (weights : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) Complex) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (crossing a b a' b' weights)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c))
  let crossRight := fun {P Q S S' T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P)
      (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S' Q) (c' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S')
      (weights : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b c)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b' c')) Complex) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))
          (crossing b c b' c' weights))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b')
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c')))
  (∀ f : F,
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom bottomEmbedding f : U) = u * (f : U) * u⁻¹ ∧
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom topEmbedding f : U) = v * (f : U) * v⁻¹) ∧
  (∀ (map : LinearMap (RingHom.id (MonoidAlgebra Complex G)) (MonoidAlgebra Complex G)
      (MonoidAlgebra Complex G)) (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G),
    map z = z * map 1) ∧
  (∀ (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top) (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G),
    mergedEvaluation diagram z = z * multiplier diagram) ∧
  (∀ d e : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top,
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval d = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval e ↔ multiplier d = multiplier e) ∧
  (∀ p : G,
    let rightMul := fun z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G => z * MonoidAlgebra.single p 1
    let rightLinear := ∀ (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) (r : MonoidAlgebra Complex F),
      rightMul (z * along bottomEmbedding r) = rightMul z * along topEmbedding r
    let intertwines := ∀ f : F,
      (u * (f : U) * u⁻¹) * (p : U) = (p : U) * (v * (f : U) * v⁻¹)
    (rightLinear ↔ intertwines) ∧ (intertwines ↔ allowed p)) ∧
  (∀ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (x₁ : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd)) Complex)
      (x₂ : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd df)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be ef)) Complex)
      (x₃ : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) topPair) Complex),
    let left := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossLeft ga ad gb bd df x₁)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossRight gb bd df be ef x₂) (crossLeft gb be gc ce ef x₃))
    realizes left (dotValue x₁ * along gb (dotValue x₂) * dotValue x₃)) ∧
  (∀ (B' : Subgroup U) (ab' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (cb' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C) (b'f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B')
      (y₁ : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ad df)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ab' b'f)) Complex)
      (y₂ : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ab')
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc cb')) Complex)
      (y₃ : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp cb' b'f)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ce ef)) Complex),
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossRight ga ad df ab' b'f y₁)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossLeft ga ab' gc cb' b'f y₂) (crossRight gc cb' b'f ce ef y₃))
    realizes right (along ga (dotValue y₁) * dotValue y₂ * along gc (dotValue y₃)))

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G A D F C E : Subgroup U)
    (repGA repAD repDF repGC repCE repEF : U)
    (hGA : ∀ a : A, repGA * (a : U) * repGA⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hAD : ∀ d : D, repAD * (d : U) * repAD⁻¹ ∈ A)
    (hDF : ∀ f : F, repDF * (f : U) * repDF⁻¹ ∈ D)
    (hGC : ∀ c : C, repGC * (c : U) * repGC⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hCE : ∀ e : E, repCE * (e : U) * repCE⁻¹ ∈ C)
    (hEF : ∀ f : F, repEF * (f : U) * repEF⁻¹ ∈ E),
  let ga := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGA hGA
  let ad := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repAD hAD
  let df := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repDF hDF
  let gc := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGC hGC
  let ce := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repCE hCE
  let ef := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repEF hEF
  let bottomPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ad
  let topPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc ce
  let word := fun {P Q S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)
  let bottom := word ga ad df
  let top := word gc ce ef
  let splitBottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) bottomPair df)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp ga ad)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up df)))
  let mergeTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) gc ce)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ef)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp topPair ef)
  let mergedEvaluation := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top)
      (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical splitBottom
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical diagram mergeTop)))
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z))
  let multiplier := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top) =>
    mergedEvaluation diagram 1
  let DotWeights := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (a b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) =>
    Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) Complex
  let crossing := fun {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (weights : DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.linearUpDot weights)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp a' b'))
  let crossLeft := fun {P Q Q' S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (weights : DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (crossing a b a' b' weights)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c))
  let crossRight := fun {P Q S S' T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P)
      (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S' Q) (c' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S')
      (weights : DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b c)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b' c')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))
          (crossing b c b' c' weights))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b')
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c')))
  let LeftLabels :=
    Σ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
      DotWeights bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd) ×
      DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd df) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be ef) ×
      DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) topPair

    Σ (B' : Subgroup U) (ab' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (cb' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C) (b'f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B'),
      DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ad df) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ab' b'f) ×
      DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ab') (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc cb') ×
      DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp cb' b'f) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ce ef)
  let leftDiagram : LeftLabels → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, gb, bd, be, x₁, x₂, x₃⟩ =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossLeft ga ad gb bd df x₁)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossRight gb bd df be ef x₂)
          (crossLeft gb be gc ce ef x₃))
  let rightDiagram : RightLabels → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, ab', cb', b'f, y₁, y₂, y₃⟩ =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossRight ga ad df ab' b'f y₁)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossLeft ga ab' gc cb' b'f y₂)
          (crossRight gc cb' b'f ce ef y₃))
  let leftMultiplier := fun d : LeftLabels => multiplier (leftDiagram d)
  let rightMultiplier := fun d : RightLabels => multiplier (rightDiagram d)
  ∃ (φ : LeftLabels → RightLabels) (ψ : RightLabels → LeftLabels),
    (∀ d : LeftLabels, rightMultiplier (φ d) = leftMultiplier d) ∧
    (∀ d : RightLabels, leftMultiplier (ψ d) = rightMultiplier d) ∧
    (∀ d : LeftLabels, leftMultiplier (ψ (φ d)) = leftMultiplier d) ∧
    (∀ d : RightLabels, rightMultiplier (φ (ψ d)) = rightMultiplier d)

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G A D F C E : Subgroup U)
    (repGA repAD repDF repGC repCE repEF : U)
    (hGA : ∀ a : A, repGA * (a : U) * repGA⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hAD : ∀ d : D, repAD * (d : U) * repAD⁻¹ ∈ A)
    (hDF : ∀ f : F, repDF * (f : U) * repDF⁻¹ ∈ D)
    (hGC : ∀ c : C, repGC * (c : U) * repGC⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hCE : ∀ e : E, repCE * (e : U) * repCE⁻¹ ∈ C)
    (hEF : ∀ f : F, repEF * (f : U) * repEF⁻¹ ∈ E),
  let ga := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGA hGA
  let ad := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repAD hAD
  let df := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repDF hDF
  let gc := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGC hGC
  let ce := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repCE hCE
  let ef := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repEF hEF
  let bottomPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ad
  let topPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc ce
  let word := fun {P Q S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)
  let bottom := word ga ad df
  let top := word gc ce ef
  let splitBottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) bottomPair df)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp ga ad)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up df)))
  let mergeTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) gc ce)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ef)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp topPair ef)
  let mergedEvaluation := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top)
      (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical splitBottom
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical diagram mergeTop)))
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z))
  let multiplier := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top) =>
    mergedEvaluation diagram 1
  let DotWeights := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (a b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) =>
    Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) Complex
  let crossing := fun {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (weights : DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.linearUpDot weights)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp a' b'))
  let crossLeft := fun {P Q Q' S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (weights : DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (crossing a b a' b' weights)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c))
  let crossRight := fun {P Q S S' T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P)
      (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S' Q) (c' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S')
      (weights : DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b c)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b' c')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))
          (crossing b c b' c' weights))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b')
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c')))
  let LeftLabels :=
    Σ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
      DotWeights bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd) ×
      DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd df) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be ef) ×
      DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) topPair
  let RightLabels :=
    Σ (B' : Subgroup U) (ab' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (cb' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C) (b'f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B'),
      DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ad df) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ab' b'f) ×
      DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ab') (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc cb') ×
      DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp cb' b'f) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ce ef)
  let leftDiagram : LeftLabels → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, gb, bd, be, x₁, x₂, x₃⟩ =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossLeft ga ad gb bd df x₁)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossRight gb bd df be ef x₂)
          (crossLeft gb be gc ce ef x₃))
  let rightDiagram : RightLabels → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, ab', cb', b'f, y₁, y₂, y₃⟩ =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossRight ga ad df ab' b'f y₁)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossLeft ga ab' gc cb' b'f y₂)
          (crossRight gc cb' b'f ce ef y₃))
  let leftMultiplier := fun d : LeftLabels => multiplier (leftDiagram d)
  let rightMultiplier := fun d : RightLabels => multiplier (rightDiagram d)
  let leftEval := fun d : LeftLabels => MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (leftDiagram d)
  let rightEval := fun d : RightLabels => MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (rightDiagram d)
  let leftSetoid := Setoid.ker leftEval
  let rightSetoid := Setoid.ker rightEval
  ∃ (φ : LeftLabels → RightLabels) (ψ : RightLabels → LeftLabels)
    (classes : Equiv (Quotient leftSetoid) (Quotient rightSetoid)),
    (∀ d : LeftLabels, rightMultiplier (φ d) = leftMultiplier d) ∧
    (∀ e : RightLabels, leftMultiplier (ψ e) = rightMultiplier e) ∧
    (∀ d : LeftLabels, classes (Quotient.mk leftSetoid d) = Quotient.mk rightSetoid (φ d)) ∧
    (∀ e : RightLabels,
      Equiv.symm classes (Quotient.mk rightSetoid e) = Quotient.mk leftSetoid (ψ e)) ∧
    (∀ (d : LeftLabels) (e : RightLabels), rightEval e = leftEval d →
      classes (Quotient.mk leftSetoid d) = Quotient.mk rightSetoid e) ∧
    (∀ (e : RightLabels) (d : LeftLabels), leftEval d = rightEval e →
      Equiv.symm classes (Quotient.mk rightSetoid e) = Quotient.mk leftSetoid d)

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let de := comp d e
  let ade := comp a de
  let bcf := comp bc f
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let top := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let mergedBottom := tensor (down a) (up bc)
  let mergedTop := tensor (up de) (down f)
  let splitBottom : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex mergedBottom bottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp b c))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down a) (up b) (up c))
  let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex top mergedTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp d e)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down f))
  let eval := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical splitBottom
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical diagram mergeTop)))
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {r : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r'))
  let parallel := fun {K H H' L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (α' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H' K) (β' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H')
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α β) (comp α' β')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) α β)

        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp α' β'))

      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α η) (comp β θ)) =>
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ x w = z}
  let ProjectionLabel := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
    {x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α η) (comp β θ) // finiteFibers α β η θ x}

      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)

  let Q := fun (p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ade bcf) (w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis mergedTop).carrier) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a bc
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a bc de f p w)
  let Qstar := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (project a bc de f p))

    MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a) ⊓
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p)))

  let lower := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom ade)
  let linearVertex := fun {s t : MackeyDiagrams.Word G F} {X : Type u}

      (fun x => MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (weights x) (vertex x))
      (Finset.toList (Finsupp.support weights)))

      (second : Y → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex s t)
      (third : Z → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex t top) =>

      eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (first x)

    (∀ (g : G) (h : F),
      Q p (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction de)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction f) g h) =
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a g * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p *
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom bc h)) ∧
  (∀ (p : Parameter) (z : A),
    Qstar p (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a bc z) 1) =
      Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (p.property (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a bc z)))
        (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1) ∧
    (z ∈ Set.range (Q p.val) →
      Nat.card {w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis mergedTop).carrier // Q p.val w = z} =
        Subgroup.relIndex lower (intersection p.val))) ∧
  (∀ {B : Subgroup U} (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
    let left₁ := fun x : ProjectionLabel a b r s =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (project a b r s x) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up c))
    let left₂ := fun y : ProjectionLabel s c t f => atRight (up r) (project s c t f y)
    let left₃ := fun z : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (parallel r t d e z) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down f))
    evaluates left₁ left₂ left₃) ∧
  (∀ {B' : Subgroup U} (u' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B'),
    let right₁ := fun ell : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp u' w) =>
      atRight (down a) (parallel b c u' w ell)
    let right₂ := fun m : ProjectionLabel a u' d v =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (project a u' d v m) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up w))
    let right₃ := fun n : ProjectionLabel v w e f => atRight (up d) (project v w e f n)
    evaluates right₁ right₂ right₃)

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G A D F C E : Subgroup U)

    (ce : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (ef : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E),

  let topPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc ce
  let word := fun {P Q S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor

      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)

        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up df)))

    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) gc ce)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ef)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp topPair ef)

      (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical splitBottom
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical diagram mergeTop)))
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z))

    mergedEvaluation diagram 1
  let DotWeights := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (a b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) =>
    Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) Complex
  let crossing := fun {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')

        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))

    Σ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),

      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (rightDiagram right)
