      (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (x₁ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd))
      (x₂ : DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd df)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be ef))
      (x₃ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) topPair),
      let left : LeftLabels := ⟨B, gb, bd, be, singleDot x₁, x₂, singleDot x₃⟩
      represents gb 1 ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd = bottomPair ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be = topPair ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₁ = 1 ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₃ = 1 ∧
      MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (Subgroup.inclusion hBG)
        (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₂)) = m ∧
      leftMultiplier left = m ∧ sameEvaluation left right) ∧
  (∀ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (x₁ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd))
      (x₂ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd df)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be ef))
      (x₃ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) topPair),
    let left : LeftLabels := ⟨B, gb, bd, be, singleDot x₁, singleDot x₂, singleDot x₃⟩
    let p := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₁ *
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom gb (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₂) *
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₃

      represents gc repGC ∧ represents ce repCE ∧ represents ef repEF ∧

      (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₂ : U) = repBD' * repDF * repEF⁻¹ * repBE⁻¹ ∧
      (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₃ : U) = repGB' * repBE' * repCE⁻¹ * repGC⁻¹ ∧

        let B'' := conjugate repDF⁻¹ D ⊓ conjugate repEF⁻¹ E
        let B' := conjugate τ B''
        ∃ (ab' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A) (cb' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C)

          (y₃ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp cb' b'f)
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ce ef)),

Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.1, “Other choices of internal group,” p. 21. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The six boundary labels are fixed conjugation embeddings, which encode the six centralizer cosets. For ψ, the subgroup conditions use the images of the boundary embeddings and the support of the complex multiplier. For φ, each given triple of group-element dots admits a choice of representatives at its crossings. The three dot factorizations specify which representatives can be used, including the primed representatives of internal labels. The intersection uses the chosen DF and EF representatives, and the conclusion applies to every τ in the ambient group. Both directions compare the evaluations of the typed diagrams at the fixed boundary. ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)

  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let hom := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom U _

  let ad := comp a d
  let de := comp d e
  let ade := comp a de

    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp b c))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down a) (up b) (up c))
  let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex top mergedTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp d e)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down f))

    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical splitBottom
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical diagram mergeTop)))

      {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {r : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r'))
  let parallel := fun {K H H' L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (α' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H' K) (β' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H')
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α β) (comp α' β')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) α β)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot x)

      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
    {x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α η) (comp β θ) //
      ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ x w = z}}

      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)

      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let de := comp d e
  let cf := comp c f
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let top := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let mergedBottom := tensor (down a) (up bc)
  let mergedTop := tensor (up de) (down f)
  let splitBottom : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex mergedBottom bottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp b c))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down a) (up b) (up c))
  let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex top mergedTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp d e)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down f))
  let eval := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical splitBottom
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical diagram mergeTop)))
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {r : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r'))
  let parallel := fun {K H H' L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (α' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H' K) (β' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H')
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α β) (comp α' β')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) α β)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot x)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp α' β'))
  let finiteFibers := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α η) (comp β θ)) =>
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ x w = z}
  let ProjectionLabel := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
    {x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α η) (comp β θ) // finiteFibers α β η θ x}
  let project := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : ProjectionLabel α β η θ) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) α β η θ x.val x.property
  let Parameter := ProjectionLabel a bc de f
  let linearVertex := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {s t : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H} {X : Type u}
      (vertex : X → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex s t) (weights : Finsupp X Complex) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.finiteSum (List.map
      (fun x => MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (weights x) (vertex x))
      (Finset.toList (Finsupp.support weights)))
  let Qstar := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (project a bc de f p))
  let combination := fun (coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex) =>
    Finsupp.sum coeff (fun p weight => weight • Qstar p)

      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)

      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj p))
        (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom β))

    Subgroup.relIndex adeRange (intersection a bc (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p.val))

      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)

    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ x.val

      (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)

    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal lower (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (atRight (up r) (project s c t f y))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (parallel r t d e z)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down f))))
  let fullIntersection := fun (p : Parameter)
      (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top) =>
    let element := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p.val
    let B := Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype G)
      (Subgroup.comap (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a) (intersection a b element))
    ∃ (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
      (∀ v : B, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom r v : U) = (v : U)) ∧
      (∀ v : B,
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom s v) =
          element⁻¹ *
            MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom r v) *
            element) ∧
      comp r t = de ∧ comp s t = cf ∧
      ∃ (x : ProjectionLabel a b r s) (y : ProjectionLabel s c t f)
        (z : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de),
        MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x.val = element ∧
        MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y.val = 1 ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element z = 1 ∧
        hasFiberSize (basisMap a b r s x) 1 ∧
        hasFiberSize (basisMap s c t f y) (n p) ∧
        diagram = left r s t (project a b r s x) y z
  let commonGroup := fun (coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex)
      (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top) =>
    let t := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id E
    ∃ (x : Parameter → ProjectionLabel a b de cf)
      (y : ProjectionLabel cf c t f) (z : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp de t) de),
      (∀ p : Parameter,
        MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (x p).val = MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p.val ∧
        ∀ v, Nat.card {w // basisMap a b de cf (x p) w = v} ≤ Subgroup.index deRange) ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y.val = 1 ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element z = 1 ∧
      hasFiberSize (basisMap cf c t f y) 1 ∧
      diagram = left de cf t (linearVertex (fun p => project a b de cf (x p)) coeff) y z
  (∀ p : Parameter, ∃ diagram, fullIntersection p diagram ∧ eval diagram = Qstar p) ∧
  (Subgroup.FiniteIndex deRange →
    ∀ coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex,
      ∃ diagram, commonGroup coeff diagram ∧ eval diagram = combination coeff) ∧
  (∀ {B' : Subgroup U} (u' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B'),
    let right₁ := fun ell : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp u' w) =>
      atRight (down a) (parallel b c u' w ell)
    let right₂ := fun m : ProjectionLabel a u' d v =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (project a u' d v m) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up w))

      (ms : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel a u' d v) Complex)
      (ns : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel v w e f) Complex),

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let hom := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let ad := comp a d
  let de := comp d e
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let top := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let mergedBottom := tensor (down a) (up bc)
  let mergedTop := tensor (up de) (down f)
  let splitBottom : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex mergedBottom bottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp b c))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down a) (up b) (up c))
  let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex top mergedTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp d e)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down f))
  let eval := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical splitBottom
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical diagram mergeTop)))
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {r : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r'))
  let parallel := fun {K H H' L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (α' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H' K) (β' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H')
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α β) (comp α' β')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) α β)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot x)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp α' β'))
  let ProjectionLabel := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
    {x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α η) (comp β θ) //
      ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ x w = z}}
  let project := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : ProjectionLabel α β η θ) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) α β η θ x.val x.property
  let linearVertex := fun {s t : MackeyDiagrams.Word G F} {X : Type u}
      (vertex : X → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex s t) (weights : Finsupp X Complex) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.finiteSum (List.map
      (fun x => MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (weights x) (vertex x))
      (Finset.toList (Finsupp.support weights)))
  let labelVertex := fun {s t : MackeyDiagrams.Word G F} {X : Type u}
      (vertex : X → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex s t)
      (label : Sum X (Finsupp X Complex)) =>
    Sum.elim vertex (linearVertex vertex) label
  let stack := fun {s t : MackeyDiagrams.Word G F}
      (first : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom s)
      (second : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex s t)
      (third : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex t top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical first (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical second third)
  let VertexLabel := fun X : Type u => Sum X (Finsupp X Complex)
  let Left := Σ B : Subgroup U,
    Σ r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G,
    Σ s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D,
    Σ t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B,
      VertexLabel (ProjectionLabel a b r s) ×
      VertexLabel (ProjectionLabel s c t f) ×
      VertexLabel (MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de)
  let Right := Σ B' : Subgroup U,
    Σ j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A,
    Σ v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B',
    Σ w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B',
      VertexLabel (MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp j w)) ×
      VertexLabel (ProjectionLabel a j d v) ×
      VertexLabel (ProjectionLabel v w e f)
  let leftDiagram : Left → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, r, s, t, xs, ys, zs⟩ =>
      stack
        (labelVertex (fun x => MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (project a b r s x)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up c))) xs)
        (labelVertex (fun y => atRight (up r) (project s c t f y)) ys)
        (labelVertex (fun z => MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (parallel r t d e z)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down f))) zs)
  let rightDiagram : Right → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, j, v, w, ells, ms, ns⟩ =>
      stack
        (labelVertex (fun ell => atRight (down a) (parallel b c j w ell)) ells)
        (labelVertex (fun m => MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (project a j d v m)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up w))) ms)
        (labelVertex (fun n => atRight (up d) (project v w e f n)) ns)
  let Parameter := ProjectionLabel a bc de f
  let Qstar := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (project a bc de f p))
  let expansion := fun (coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex) =>
    Finsupp.sum coeff (fun p weight => weight • Qstar p)
  let P := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    MonoidHom.range (hom ad) ⊔
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p.val)))
        (MonoidHom.range (hom bc))
  let middleFinite := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    Subgroup.FiniteIndex (Subgroup.subgroupOf (MonoidHom.range (hom ad))
      (MonoidHom.range (hom a) ⊓ P p))
  let leftEval := fun shape : Left => eval (leftDiagram shape)
  let rightEval := fun shape : Right => eval (rightDiagram shape)
  let leftClasses := Setoid.ker leftEval
  let rightClasses := Setoid.ker rightEval
  (∀ l : Left, ∃ coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex,
    leftEval l = expansion coeff ∧
    (∀ other : Finsupp Parameter Complex, leftEval l = expansion other → other = coeff) ∧
    ((∃ ds : List Right,
      eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.finiteSum (List.map rightDiagram ds)) = leftEval l) ↔
      ∀ p ∈ Finsupp.support coeff, middleFinite p)) ∧
  (∀ p : Parameter, middleFinite p → ∃ r : Right, rightEval r = Qstar p) ∧
  (Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (hom d)) →
    ∀ l : Left, ∃ r : Right, rightEval r = leftEval l) ∧
  (∀ r : Right, ∃ ds : List Left,
    eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.finiteSum (List.map leftDiagram ds)) = rightEval r) ∧
  (Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (hom de)) →
    ∀ r : Right, ∃ l : Left, leftEval l = rightEval r) ∧
  (Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (hom de)) ∨ Finite G →
    ∃ (replaceCase1 : Left → Right) (replaceCase2 : Right → Left)
      (replacement : Quotient leftClasses ≃ Quotient rightClasses),
      (∀ l : Left, rightEval (replaceCase1 l) = leftEval l ∧
        replacement (Quotient.mk leftClasses l) = Quotient.mk rightClasses (replaceCase1 l)) ∧
      (∀ r : Right, leftEval (replaceCase2 r) = rightEval r ∧
        Equiv.symm replacement (Quotient.mk rightClasses r) =
          Quotient.mk leftClasses (replaceCase2 r)))

  let e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C := inclusion bot_le

  let project := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}

      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)

    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) α β η θ x.val x.property
  let linearVertex := fun {s t : MackeyDiagrams.Word G F} {X : Type}

    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.finiteSum (List.map

      (ms : Sum (ProjectionLabel a j d v) (Finsupp (ProjectionLabel a j d v) Complex))

  let left := fun (x : ProjectionLabel a b r s) (y : ProjectionLabel s c t f)

    stack

  Subgroup.index (MonoidHom.range (hom f)) = 2 ∧
  P₁ = ⊤ ∧
  Subgroup.relIndex (MonoidHom.range (hom ad)) (MonoidHom.range (hom a) ⊓ P₁) =

  ¬ Subgroup.FiniteIndex (Subgroup.subgroupOf C G) ∧

  (∃ (x : ProjectionLabel a b r s) (y : ProjectionLabel s c t f)

let N := Fin 2 → Multiplicative Int
let swaps : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) →* MulAut N :=
  { toFun := fun σ =>
      { toFun := fun x i => x (Equiv.symm σ i)
        invFun := fun x i => x (σ i)
        left_inv := fun x => funext fun i => congrArg x (Equiv.symm_apply_apply σ i)
        right_inv := fun x => funext fun i => congrArg x (Equiv.apply_symm_apply σ i)
        map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
    map_one' := rfl
    map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
let U := SemidirectProduct N (Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) swaps
let base : N →* U := SemidirectProduct.inl
let permutations : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) →* U := SemidirectProduct.inr
let G := MonoidHom.range base
let C := Subgroup.map base (MonoidHom.ker (Pi.evalMonoidHom (fun _ : Fin 2 => Multiplicative Int) 1))
let D := MonoidHom.range permutations
caseOne G C D (by
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨n, _, rfl⟩ := hu
  exact ⟨n, rfl⟩)

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G A D F C E B' : Subgroup U)

    (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E)
    (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
    (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _

  let ad := down b
  let df := up d
  let ai := up i
  let fj := down j
  let gc := up c
  let ck := up k
  let ce := down e
  let ef := up f
  let bottom := tensor ga (tensor ad df)
  let top := tensor gc (tensor ce ef)

  let MiddleLabel := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k)
  let UpperLabel := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j)

  let q := fun (r : LowerLabel) (w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis FiberWord).carrier) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct b d
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r w)

    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a i)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot t)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp c k))
  let multiply := fun (s : UpperLabel) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) e f k j s
  let rightDiagram := fun
      (lower : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (tensor ad df) (tensor ai fj))
      (mid : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (tensor ga ai) (tensor gc ck))
      (upper : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (tensor ck fj) (tensor ce ef)) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id ga) lower)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal mid (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id fj))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ck fj)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id gc) upper))))

    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval diagram)
      (Finsupp.single
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)) g
          (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x)) 1)

      (t : MiddleLabel) (s : UpperLabel) (g : G) (x : D) =>
    Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (hr x)) (fun w =>
      let representative : A × F := Quotient.out w
      Finsupp.single
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction c)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ce ef))
          (g * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a representative.1 *
            MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f
            (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s *
              MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f representative.2))) (1 : Complex))

      (List.map (fun r : {r // r ∈ Finsupp.support R} =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (R r.val) (project r.val (hR r.val r.property)))
        (Finset.toList lowerSupport))

      (List.map (fun t => MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (T t) (middle t))
        (Finset.toList (Finsupp.support T)))
    let upper := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.finiteSum
      (List.map (fun s => MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (S s) (multiply s))
        (Finset.toList (Finsupp.support S)))

let swap : Multiplicative (ZMod 2) := Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod 2)

    map_mul' := by
      have cases₂ : ∀ i : Multiplicative (ZMod 2), i = 1 ∨ i = swap := by
        intro i
        change (Multiplicative.toAdd i : Fin 2) = 0 ∨ Multiplicative.toAdd i = (1 : ZMod 2)
        exact (by decide : ∀ j : Fin 2, j = 0 ∨ j = 1) (Multiplicative.toAdd i)
      have hs : swap * swap = 1 := by decide
      have hn : swap ≠ 1 := by decide
      intro i j
      rcases cases₂ i with rfl | rfl <;> rcases cases₂ j with rfl | rfl <;>
        simp only [act, one_mul, mul_one, hs, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right hn]

∀ (X : Finset Nat) (r c : Nat) (A : Fin r → Finset ↥X) (B : Fin c → Finset ↥X),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (A i)) →
  (∀ j, Finset.Nonempty (B j)) →
  Pairwise (fun i i' => Disjoint (A i) (A i')) →
  Pairwise (fun j j' => Disjoint (B j) (B j')) →
  (∀ x : ↥X, ∃ i, x ∈ A i) →
  (∀ x : ↥X, ∃ j, x ∈ B j) →
  let G := Equiv.Perm ↥X
  let blockSym := fun S : Finset ↥X =>
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : ↥X => x ∈ S))
  let K : Subgroup G := iSup (fun i => blockSym (A i))
  let H : Subgroup G := iSup (fun j => blockSym (B j))
  let Mat := {R : Fin r → Fin c → Nat //
    (∀ i, Finset.sum Finset.univ (R i) = Finset.card (A i)) ∧
    (∀ j, Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => R i j) = Finset.card (B j))}
  let rank := fun (S : Finset ↥X) (x : ↥S) =>
    ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin S rfl).symm x).val
  ∃ classify : DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G) ≃ Mat,
    (∀ (σ : G) i j, (classify (DoubleCoset.mk K H σ)).val i j =
      Finset.card (A i ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) (B j))) ∧
    ∀ R : Mat, ∃ σ : G,
      DoubleCoset.mk K H σ = classify.symm R ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) (x : ↥(A i)) (y : ↥(B j)),
        σ y.val = x.val ↔
          ∃ k : Fin (R.val i j),
            rank (A i) x =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio j) (fun j' => R.val i j') + k.val ∧
            rank (B j) y =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio i) (fun i' => R.val i' j) + k.val

  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (A i)) →
  (∀ j, Finset.Nonempty (B j)) →
  Pairwise (fun i i' => Disjoint (A i) (A i')) →
  Pairwise (fun j j' => Disjoint (B j) (B j')) →
  (∀ x : ↥X, ∃ i, x ∈ A i) →
  (∀ x : ↥X, ∃ j, x ∈ B j) →
  let G := Equiv.Perm ↥X
  let blockSym := fun S : Finset ↥X =>
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : ↥X => x ∈ S))
  let K : Subgroup G := iSup (fun i => blockSym (A i))
  let H : Subgroup G := iSup (fun j => blockSym (B j))
  ∀ σ : G,
    K ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj σ)) H =
      iSup (fun i => iSup (fun j =>
        blockSym (A i ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) (B j))))
